row.name: Tobacco Shop Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: [Tobacco Shop Simulator: Prologue is a free prologue version of Tobacco Shop Simulator. In this game, you'll have a limited amount of contracts.] This is a first-person simulation game where you step into the role of a tobacco shop owner. Work alone or with friends to expand your humble shop into a huge tobacco shop. Co-Op Mode and Single Player Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (for up to 4 players). The more players in the store, the more demanding customers will visit your store. Also, you can go solo and manage everything in the store. You can invite your friends anytime if you change your mind. Store Workflow Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products with an in-game computer or with your tablet while walking in the store, unpack the boxes, place the products into your store, and set the prices for your products. Consider the market prices while setting up your product prices in the store for customer satisfaction. Always keep your store clean so as not to lose any customers. Also, be careful with the thieves to avoid some box losses that would cause a leak in your finances. Products Please make sure your customers find all their needs in the store. Always expand your product portfolio and satisfy your customers. Cigarettes, lighters, pipes, cigars, ashtrays, hookahs, e-cigarettes, tobacco, and smoking accessories... Be aware of the market prices and purchase more products when they're cheap. Customers Place a sufficient number of checkouts to reduce the waiting time for customers. Scan products and collect payments whether in cash or with card purchases. Don't forget to fulfill the online orders. Expansions and New Teammates Expand your store and warehouse by leveling up your store and budget. Hire stockers to fill the racks. Purchase more cash registers and hire new cashiers to minimize long queues at the checkouts and to reduce waiting time for customers.
row.short_description: Run your tobacco shop in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

row.name: The Vanishing
row.detailed_description: In The Vanishing, you enter an abandoned town shrouded in mystery, a place where time itself seems to have stopped. Once a thriving community, the town is now eerily silent, with crumbling buildings, deserted streets, and a dark history buried deep beneath the surface. Your journey begins with a single question: what caused the town’s sudden demise? As you explore the empty houses, forgotten diaries, and hidden corners, you uncover a chilling secret. Years ago, during the final days of the local mine’s operation, the miners discovered ancient ruins and unearthed a body—an enigmatic woman, preserved beyond the reach of time. Her spirit, filled with rage and sorrow, has awakened and now haunts the empty town, seeking vengeance for the wrongs done to her in life. You must navigate through the town’s ghostly streets, decipher cryptic clues, and confront the spirit that lingers in the shadows. Solve puzzles, unlock secrets, and piece together the story of what truly happened. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you’ll realize that the town is not as empty as it seems, and that the spirit won’t rest until every trace of life has vanished. Will you be able to uncover the truth and put the spirit to rest, or will you become the next victim in The Vanishing?
row.short_description: The Vanishing is first person horror game. Explore an abandoned town where shadows whisper and secrets lie buried deep. Uncover the truth behind a vengeful spirit awakened from an ancient slumber. Solve puzzles, face your fears, and survive a mystery that claimed so many before you. Can you escape?

Some of them take more damage from fire and some take less damage from explosions, try to create a universal team for you and conquer the rating with it. - Progress: level up your character by sending him to the battle royale, level up your weapons and become an increasingly dangerous opponent, unleash the potential of your weapons to the maximum level. The enemy will be crushed like a worm; - Weapons: we have prepared dozens of weapons, gadgets, magic and more for you: fireballs, rockets, teleporters, swords and shurikens. All for a fun multiplayer game! - Fun! Funny cartoon characters from the Cannon Guys universe will give you a lot of emotions. It's especially nice when the strategy works and after accurate aiming the projectile hits the target, giving you a victory.

Waking up in the depths of Zeelandia's dungeon with no memory of how he got there, Li Bin must navigate the perilous streets of 1660, just before the outbreak of the infamous Siege of Fort Zeelandia War in 1661. The meticulously crafted streetscapes draw inspiration from 'La ville et le cháteau de Zélandia dans l'ile de Tayovan,' transporting players to a meticulously recreated world where every corner whispers echoes of a bygone era. row.name: Cosmic Decode
row.detailed_description: Embark on a Universe of Challenges and Mysteries in Cosmic Decode Dive into Cosmic Decode , a platforming and puzzle-solving experience set in the vast emptiness of space. This game blends environmental physics with intricate enigmas to deliver a unique and challenging gameplay adventure. Space Voyage This isn’t a fast-paced action game but rather a thoughtful journey that emphasizes exploration, puzzle-solving, and a deep sense of awe for your surroundings. Key Features: Physics-Based Exploration: Navigate zero-gravity environments, using physics to your advantage to move and solve problems in a boundless world. Ingenious Puzzles: Discover and solve intricate level puzzles that will test your logic and problem-solving skills. Immersive Atmosphere: Experience stunning visuals, from galactic backdrops to hauntingly abandoned space stations. Variety of Challenges: Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles, ensuring the experience remains fresh and engaging. Unique Art Style: A visually striking design inspired by classic sci-fi, complemented by an ambient soundtrack that enhances immersion. The Physics Cosmic Decode strives to be as realistic as possible without compromising entertainment. It incorporates Newton’s Third Law when throwing objects and leverages zero-gravity mechanics to solve intricate puzzles, making the experience both intuitive and fascinating. What to Expect This game is perfect for players who enjoy reflective, atmospheric experiences, where exploration is as vital as puzzle-solving.
row.short_description: Cosmic Decode is a space game where you explore an unknown universe, solving puzzles and discovering the reason for your situation. Immerse yourself in an adventure full of mystery and challenges at every step.

Upgrade your characteristics and talents as you wish. Will you train AIM to improve marksmanship or Strafe to become elusive? Develop an economy by dominating resources or micro-control to emerge victorious? It's up to you.
row.short_description: Esports History: Prologue is a free RPG simulator about the era of the birth of eSports. Start from scratch and work your way up to an eSports career. Use your resources and time wisely to develop a unique character and win tournaments.

row.name: Reconquer Online
row.detailed_description: Reconquer Online is an indie MMORPG that prioritizes fun and player freedom rather than grinding. This game introduces fresh mechanics like lever-controlled flame throwers, barricades, damaging fires, player collision, quests with alternative endings, lateral thinking puzzles, and different environmental interactions. There are currently 13 trainable skills, 11 quests, several bosses and challenges, and a competitive raid with high scores . Reconquer online has many unique features. These include: Player-controlled Resources: There is currently a player controlled mine and dock. Monsters sometimes drop 'essences' which can be used to guard these resources. Whoever owns the resource has access to the items it generates. Other players can defeat the guardian monsters and claim the resource for themselves. Barricades and Fires: Barricades can be used to block others while fires can be used to injure them. Mechanically unique bosses: Fight against bosses that spawn projectiles, drop boulders, switch attack styles, and more. Endless raids with high scores for those who have advanced the furthest. In-game macroing to automate the repetitive parts of game play. A caravan system instead of bank notes for transporting items. A Tiered PvP System: The PvP damage multiplier starts at 0% and slowly increases as you venture further. Public Enemies: PvP outside of the wasteland is punished with fidelity loss. Those with negative fidelity are designated 'public enemies' and are vulnerable everywhere. Alternate Endings: Choose a side in certain quests and reap different rewards. This is a game whose content will continue to grow with the player base. We believe the game will end up better by slowly introducing higher level content rather than all at once. Our goal is to release a new tier of content (+5 levels) about every three months. In addition, there will be four new biomes. Each biome will have its own major quest-line, raid, and unique items. Desert (up to level 40 content) Jungle (Up to level 60) Arctic (Up to level 80) Wasteland (Up to level 99) The long term goal is to monetize solely through memberships. Membership currently gives you the ability to choose a custom name. In the future, membership will also give you access to content above level 20. 3 months - $5 6 months - $10 1 Year - $15 Membership can be purchased in game through Steam.
row.short_description: An new indie MMORPG inspired by OSRS! Train, battle, quest, and explore a dynamic world. Solve puzzles, conquer dungeons, and fight epic battles. This game builds upon time-tested mechanics with barricades, fires, player controlled resources, endless raids, macroing, and a caravan system!

Idle Sphere's gameplay is built on simple yet engaging upgrades, allowing you to enjoy the game intuitively. Immerse yourself in the satisfying experience of zooming in and out, admiring the exquisite beauty of the spheres. The game features an extensive prestige system that adds depth to your journey. Although some upgrades may reset when you prestige, fear not! You'll emerge stronger and quickly regain your former power, ready to take on new challenges. Despite its simplicity, Idle Sphere offers a wealth of content for you to explore and enjoy. Dive into this captivating world of spheres and embark on an unforgettable incremental gaming adventure!
row.short_description: Stunning sphere-themed idle/incremental game. Experience simplicity's beauty.

row.name: Relictus: Blackout
row.detailed_description: A World in Conflict In the year 2028, tensions boil over in the remote Tarkhos Province. The fragile ceasefire between NATO-backed Global Intervention Corps (GIC) and the insurgent Red Vostok shatters as full-scale war ignites. The fight isn’t just for territory—it’s for dominance, ideology, and survival. Dive into a variety of game modes, from traditional Team Deathmatch and Free-For-All to the unique and nerve-wracking Blackout Raid . In this night-time elimination mode, you'll rely on night vision, sound (like footsteps) and pure instinct to outsmart your opponents in a no-respawn, no-killstreak environment. Choose your path with a distinct class-based loadout system that prevents overpowered 'meta' builds. Specialize as a heavy-hitting Support , a nimble Assault , a patient Sniper , or a close-quarters Engineer , each with a unique set of weapons and tactical pros and cons. With a fully reworked progression system, every match you play contributes to unlocking new weapons, emblems, and cosmetics. Experience a game where every detail matters—from the enhanced weapon SFX and immersive audio to the optimized maps with improved lighting and post-processing. Key Features: Intense, Class-Based Combat: Master four distinct classes, each with a unique role and loadout. Old-School Progression: Level up to unlock new weapons, calling cards, and cosmetic items. Optimized & Polished: Enjoy a smoother experience with reworked gunplay, improved AI, and visually enhanced maps. Streamlined Experience: Less clutter and more focus on core gameplay, providing a clean and engaging UI. With a fully reworked progression system, every match you play contributes to unlocking new weapons, emblems, and cosmetics. Experience a game where every detail matters—from the enhanced weapon SFX and immersive audio to the optimized maps with improved lighting and post-processing. Game Modes Relictus: Blackout features a growing roster of modes designed for different player mindsets and levels of intensity: Skirmish (FFA) : Solo survival in its rawest form. Every combatant is your enemy. Contact (TDM) : Classic team-on-team warfare. Secure the highest kill count through discipline and coordination. Blackout Raid (Elimination) : Squad-based, one-life-per-round tension. When you’re down, you’re out—until the next round. Dynamic Battlefields Mirzov District (Night) – Shadowy urban alleys with flickering lights and sudden ambushes. Dravon Estates – Suburban strongholds and open courtyards under fire. Tarkhos – Vehicle lanes, industrial chokepoints, and strategic rooftops. Drelsk Ridge – Mountain warfare with long-range sightlines and dangerous flanks. Core Experience Relictus: Blackout is a gritty, dark, infantry-focused multiplayer FPS that strips away arcade excess and replaces it with uncompromising realism and tension. Choose Your Side : Join the disciplined GIC or the relentless Red Vostok. Each faction has unique operators with distinct visual designs and gear reflecting their culture, training, and battlefield philosophy. High Replayability : Thanks to a blend of operator variety, dynamic maps, and multiple game modes, no two matches ever feel the same. Host Your Own Servers : Players can run dedicated or peer-hosted matches, set their own rules, tweak map rotations, and cultivate unique communities. Progression Without Paywalls : No battle passes. No pay-to-win. Earn your progression through gameplay alone. Unlock cosmetic options, insignia, and operator gear by playing and winning. Why Relictus: Blackout Stands Apart Authenticity at Its Core : Weapons feel weighty and lethal, movement is deliberate, and firefights are fast and decisive. Operator Identity : Choose from visually distinctive operators for each faction, representing the ethos of their side—from GIC’s high-tech tactical gear to Red Vostok’s rugged, scavenged combat rigs. Built by Players, for Players : Server hosting, custom rule sets, and clan support mean the community shapes the war. No Fluff, Just Grit : No fantastical gadgets, no out-of-place cosmetics. This is modern warfare stripped to the bone. Dynamic AI Bots : For training or filling servers, bots act aggressively and unpredictably, offering both practice and challenge. The War Continues In Relictus: Blackout, there are no safe zones. Every match is another chapter in a war without end. The GIC fights to stabilize the province and maintain global order. Red Vostok seeks to burn that order to the ground. Your role is simple: pick a side, gear up, and survive. This is not a war for glory. It’s a war for survival. Relictus: Blackout — The darkness has a name.
row.short_description: Relictus: Blackout is a grounded, tactical multiplayer shooter designed for players who crave a focused and intense combat experience. Combining the fast-paced action of classic shooters with deliberate, class-based gameplay, Relictus puts strategy and skill at the forefront of every match.

row.name: Stop and Breathe
row.detailed_description: Game Overview Discover the importance of breathing during moments of stress or anxiousness. Learn how to control your breathing to achieve serenity and calmness. Solve a series of fun puzzles with a multitude of gameplay mechanics. The Story Ace is a young teen who starts to feel anxious about kicking off their day at school. As they head towards the school entrance, their anxiousness begins to grow and intensify until they experience an intense panic attack. Feeling scared and overwhelmed, Ace gets closed off into a warped mind world where they now need to find a way out. With the help of their companion Zen, Ace learns the proper timings and physical stance for the Belly Breathing technique, which they can now utilize to expel their anxiousness and colour the way forward. Gameplay In this mind world, Ace must navigate a disjointed version of their school by performing a series of simple platforming challenges, breathing the anxiousness away, and solving an array of puzzles. Upon entering each new section of the school, mental blockers and a lack of colour fill the surrounding area, making it difficult for Ace to achieve their goal of escaping. By finding a calm space to center themselves, Ace can perform Life Breathing to bring colour back bit by bit and remove their mental blockers. Use the power of controlled breath when interacting with breathing terminals to inflate and deflate large balloons, change the directional air flow of fans, and rotate platforms to move forward. To progress to the next section, find and place large books into their proper shelves to open doors and move on to the next page of the Ace’s journey.
row.short_description: A 3D puzzle platformer that teaches you a breathing technique to help with your anxiety! Calm your mind by performing the breathing technique, Belly Breathing! Traverse a school environment, solve puzzles, move platforms, all while being accompanied by your companion, Zen!

row.name: Arcane Afterfall
row.detailed_description: ✨ Arcane Afterfall Update: Bug Fixes, Improvements & Exciting Changes Ahead! 🔮 🔮 Hey everyone! Thank you for your active feedback – we carefully read all your comments and suggestions, and it's because of you that Arcane Afterfall keeps getting better with every update! ⚒️ What’s new? - We’ve fixed multiple bugs to make the game more stable and enjoyable for all players. - Added a location map to help you more easily navigate the world that has lost its magic! - Faction restrictions in the Arcane Tower have been removed – groups are now formed solely based on player levels: 9-12, 13-16, 17-19, 20+. This change will help you take on challenges more easily - You can now discard unnecessary quest items if the associated quest is not in your journal – no more cluttered inventory! - System messages that previously might have appeared in the wrong language will now be displayed in the selected language. ✨ What’s next? We’re already working on new updates with exciting improvements and content. Stay tuned to be the first to know about upcoming changes! 💬 Share your thoughts, let us know what you love and what could be improved – your feedback truly matters to us! About the Game 🎮 Welcome to Arcane Afterfall – a role-playing game inspired by the classics of the genre, where magic no longer reigns, and those who dream of restoring it must fight for their cause. This is a world where people from Earth arrived in search of the last drop of magical energy-only to discover new mysteries, ancient threats, and the struggle for survival. 🔍 Explore a mysterious world filled with intrigue and unexpected encounters. Join secret organizations, solve riddles, and hunt for rare Easter eggs 🎭 hidden in the most unexpected places. Here, every choice has consequences, and knowledge is power 📖✨. TACTICAL BATTLES AND DEADLY ENEMIES 🔥 The Arcane Afterfall combat system is designed for true strategists. Turn-based battles require a thoughtful approach-use unique abilities ⚡, combine talents, analyze enemy weaknesses, and find vulnerabilities 🎯 to gain the upper hand, even in the most challenging fights. 👹 But the real trials await you in boss fights. Gigantic demons 😈, ancient artifact-bound entities 🔮, and mechanical titans 🤖-each boss requires a unique strategy. Defeating them grants legendary rewards 🏆, but to triumph, you must rely not only on strength but also on cunning 🧠. DUNGEONS, PVP, AND THE 'TOWER OF ARCANA' ⚔️ Venture into dark dungeons-alone or with a group. Every labyrinth holds its own secrets and deadly traps ☠️, and in its depths, powerful bosses and treasures 💎 await. For those who enjoy battling other players, PvP arenas are open, where you can test your skills in team fights 🏅. And in the Tower of Arcana, you’ll start with no equipment and must find different ways to emerge victorious-only your skill determines the outcome. A WORLD FULL OF MYSTERIES AND POSSIBILITIES 🔮 Unravel the secrets of the nameless City by penetrating its Inside Out. Challenge the Shaved Sisters gang or become a paladin of the Last Order. Become a warrior of the Swamp Legion or set out to explore Zone 51 👽. Discover what lies hidden within the Confluxion and find your way through space and time in star sneakers. row.name: Feika AI Game Engine
row.detailed_description: Feika is a tool that uses AI's thought logic as the game logic. It can also be understood as a tool to build multiple agents and have them cooperate to complete tasks. Games, software, or editor tools can be built and designed using text descriptions. Utilize AI to quickly construct UI interfaces. Experience or share outstanding works through the workshop. Main Advantages: AI generates environment-altering behaviors directly based on user requirements. This approach is more intuitive and easier to implement than traditional programming, with almost no development barriers and low AI capability requirements. Users can design multiple agents to create more complex requirements and design their thought logic, allowing for the creation of content of any scale without being limited by AI capabilities. Provides support for interfaces (web pages) as the most basic interaction and visual experience. Advantages of Making Games: Game logic is about game rules, which are closer to human thought logic in design and require uncertainty and dynamic changes, involving intuitive judgments. New Experiences in AI-Driven Games Features of AI-Driven Games: Direct Rule Understanding: AI can directly understand and apply the intent of game rules without having to program every possibility, kipping straight to outcome prediction. This makes rule design more flexible and natural, allowing focus on the experience itself rather than technical implementation limitations. Intelligent NPCs: Non-player characters in the game are genuinely AI-driven, possessing unique personalities and realistic reactions. They can make flexible decisions based on the environment, engage in natural conversations, dynamically plan tactics in battles, and cooperate seamlessly as teammates. Integration of Novel or Movie Features: By utilizing features from novels and movies, the interactions and communications between players and NPCs, as well as between NPCs themselves, can drive the narrative development. Examples: Players act as heads of a spy organization, with AI dynamically generating agents' behaviors and missions based on the situation and players' decisions, making each mission unpredictable and challenging. Players guide the development of a civilization, with AI simulating social and cultural changes in real-time based on players' decisions, shaping a unique historical process full of variations. Players act as judges, facing real-time adjustments of various political factions' struggles and undercurrents by AI. Players act as time travelers, with AI dynamically generating historical events and characters based on players' choices and timelines. Each journey affects the development of history, creating unique timelines and stories. Players as wizards enter a meticulously designed magical world by developers. In this world, AI dynamically changes the world based on players' choices and actions. Expertise in Text-based Logic-Driven Games Highly adept at text-based games, interactive novels, role-playing games, or any Text-based games. You can design a novel as a game, provide an outline, and ensure interactivity and plot coherence through the collaboration of agents. AI's intelligence is currently relatively low, so letting AI independently create stories is not effective. The more detail provided, the better results AI will give. Expertise in UI-Focused Games Skilled in developing UI-type games, such as idle games, card games, or simple single mini-games. Many simple UI games often don't even require agent assistance. Games can be constructed solely through different interfaces interactions and data. Feika is currently in the early stages of development, and its features are not yet stable. Many functionalities and ideas are still under development.
row.short_description: Feika is a game engine that drives logic through AI decision-making, breaking the limitations of traditional programming models and enabling the creation of more flexible and dynamic gaming experiences.

row.name: Reconquista
row.detailed_description: Experience the Iberian Peninsula in the late Reconquista era through a board game. Granada, once the hegemony of Al-Andalus, after centuries of Reconquista War, is on the verge of collapse. Meanwhile, it was also a long time ago that the three Christian kingdoms of Castilla, Aragon, and Portugal fought under the cause of a holy war. The Iberian Peninsula is now in an era of warring states where each country's beneficial relationships are intertwined. There are two victory conditions. One is to have the most territory at the end of 32 rounds, and the other is to win 3 times of battle in which all 4 countries participate every 10 rounds. Each country's units have their own characteristics. Among these, noble class units can only be acquired by its own country, while militia and men at arms can be acquired by other countries as well. Castilla: High defense, overall decent stats Aragon: High defense, excellent melee troops Portugal: Excellent ranged ability, weak melee troops Granada: Granada's units have low overall stats and are heavily reliant on noble cards, but they can be excellent at both melee and ranged. Game Systems 1. Kingdom phase This is the strategy phase in the form of a board game. All the player's strategic decisions are made only in this phase. Roll the dice, move, and decide on actions at the destination. 2. Deck building When you get cards in the Kingdom phase, you can adjust the positions of the cards in the deck. If between the flags there are only cards of the same country, each card gains a beneficial effect. 3. Battle Units are placed from the rear starting from the left of the deck. Battle is automatic and turn-based, greatly inspired by many tabletop wargames. You should observe the battle to refine your deck or improve your grand strategy. Multiplayer Up to 4 players can compete directly via local multiplayer or Remote play.

Embody a young Diluvian Knight, Qasar, and face the brutal Myrmidon invasion of your tomb-ship. Featuring a brand-new level, new characters, story and dialogues, Diluvian Ultra: Awakening is an excellent introduction for new explorers of the game’s universe, as well as an interesting new addition to veterans who have already completed the first chapter of Diluvian Ultra. Strategic combat Diluvian Ultra’s combat is built around a dual-damage system where you have to combine weapons to be effective. Armour absorbs damage, but some weapons are designed to quickly strip it off your targets - unable to kill them, but exposing them for a single lethal blow. You have to be careful though, as enemies will mix their attacks in the same way. Collect and consume blood to upgrade your weapons and pick up various power-ups at the opportune moment, to become vengeance incarnate - if only for a while! Keep it moving Surviving in Diluvian Ultra is all about mobility. Dodge enemy fire while you chain together ranged attacks with close combat blows and devastating ground slams. Double-jump, dash, find cover and even deflect projectiles with your sword, but never stay in one place for too long! Organic philosophy Your spaceship home is a living combination of flesh and stone, and so it is with your arsenal of weapons; use both traditional Tech weapons as well as grotesque, living Organic armaments, and don’t forget to take good care of your closest companion, your sentient Squire Gun. Epic story Diluvian Ultra may be an over the top retro FPS filled with frenetic action, but all that carnage is set on a background of an epic, tragic story tackling the themes of fanaticism, trauma, betrayal and hope for redemption, playing out in neo-gothic architectural set pieces and immense, cathedral-like spaceships.
row.short_description: Diluvian Ultra: Awakening shows a never-before seen part of Diluvian Ultra's story, preceding the events of the main game. As a young Diluvian Knight, stage a heroic defense against insurmountable odds, in this single-player FPS with a retro aesthetic and fast-paced, strategic combat.

row.detailed_description: The mighty Dahlan Empire is falling, ravaged by a mysterious plague and internal unrest. While surviving powers and invading nations fight among themselves, adventurers and mercenaries venture inside this land full of opportunities. All characters will interpret what’s happening based on their morality and their faction. Start your journey in the Prologue, and then carry on with your save into the final game, where you will be able to join factions and level up without restrictions! The characters will judge your good and evil deeds based on their personality or faction. You may be a robber, despised by common folk, but selling stolen goods could kick-start your career in the local crime groups! Factions will fight against each other, pillaging and conquering settlements. Some may become major players in the area. Others may be destroyed forever. Create and customize your main character in every aspect, and roleplay your alter-ego in any way you want, without any external constraint. Carve your own path, whether you join the Astralite clergy to fight against the heretics or steal apples from commoners! Many paths are available to you: criminal mastermind, righteous hero, ruthless mercenary, or wise archeologist. Smash your enemies with a complex yet accessible turn-based combat system! Thanks to a unique combat system you can experiment with Skills and Items combinations. Find overpowered combos and destroy everyone stupid enough to fight you! Use a stealth system to do anything you want. Steal something? Check! Assassinate someone? Check! Watch people sleep? Check! Pickpocket Marco during a quest and use his keys to rob his house while he's still kidnapped? Quite specific, but still doable! Enjoy Several hours of playtime and saves compatible with the final release version , so that you won't lose any progress!

row.name: Project Nihilum - Zero
row.detailed_description: Stuck in an underground laboratory without any memories, you witness horrible crimes. Knowing you will be next one day, you start planning your escape. Who can you trust? How can you control the power you feel inside of you? And will you ever fully recover your lost memories along with the truth? -x- Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel set in a futuristic, dystopian world where reality and illusion collide. As brainwashed, kidnapped inmate in an underground laboratory, you will navigate a web of secrets, strange entities, and choices that will give you insight into different points of view of the story. -x- “They whisper in the dark. Do you hear them? The Origin calls to you, following you through floor after floor of the laboratory. You’re not the first to walk these corridors, and you won’t be the last. But maybe, just maybe, you’ll be the one who finally understands. Step into the void, make your choice, or let the choice make you. What will you become? You have nothing left to lose. Except… some fingers, a leg, maybe a kidney or two? -x- Features: STORY: Experience a dark narrative filled with twists, hidden lore, and choices that pull you deeper into a world where nothing is as it seems. VOICE ACTING: Every character's dialogues are voiced by our talented voice actors. MUSIC: The game features original soundtracks. You can unlock and listen to them in the game's music gallery. UPDATES: The game will be updated with new episodes, adding new gameplay to each of the 3 routes. CENSOR MODE: A censor mode can be activated at the beginning, allowing the player to experience censored versions of some scenes. IMAGE GALLERY: Unlock various images throughout the story and view them in the game's gallery. MEMORIES: Discover the past of the characters in snippets by using a certain ability. ABILITIES: Play with 1 of 3 abilities: Hybrid, Shape Shifting or Mind Glimpse. Depending on the ability, you can unlock certain scenes, memories or routes. MAIN CHARACTER: The main character will not be shown in the game. A custom name and pronouns (he/she/they) can be choosen. STORY: Discover what happened to you before your memories were taken from you and chose your new 'familiy'. ROUTES: Play 1 of 3 routes and discover the overall story through different perspectives. AVAILABLE ROUTES THE LABORATORIES: The organization that kidnapped you. Why on earth would you join and help them? (Because you want to spend time with the smart science people, we know.)They will use you for their benefit, but you can do so as well. What will you encounter in the endless corridors? And will you make it out alive or become one of them? TRUE PARADISE: You want a found family? This is the route you want to play. After all, everyone will show up here for shelter. Some of them are victims, some are former employees of the Labs. And - of course - a few of them are involved in shady business, playing every trick to accomplish their plans. THE BOUNTY HUNTERS: A mysterious organization, found by an individual who is told to be no human at all. Money, hunting, and lies make it hard to believe any of them. Are you a streamer? You can stream this game IF you add a creative aspect (audio commentary, ...). Recording the game and uploading it without adding anything to it, is not allowed. We want to promote creative content creators and NOT want our game to be used for clicks and views without putting creative effort into it.

Discover 1 or 3 abilities: Mind Glimpse, Shape Shift and Hybrid. Use your ability wisely to see the past, influence the present and shape the future.

Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world where you can free-roam, engage in intense action, and live out your own criminal empire story—all in Bangla language. Key Features: Explore a Living, Breathing World : Roam the streets, hills, and cities of a detailed, open-world environment inspired by real-life Bangladesh. Whether you're cruising through crowded markets, speeding down highways, or navigating rural backroads, every corner of the world is packed with life. Role-Playing Story : Dive into a series of immersive, narrative-driven roleplay stories inspired by the world of crime, power struggles, and gang warfare. Each mission and event unfolds a deep, branching storyline with unexpected twists and turns. Free Roam and Dynamic Action : Free-roaming gameplay lets you take control of the city, explore every nook and cranny, and interact with a diverse range of characters. From high-speed car chases to intense shootouts, the world is your playground. Engage in thrilling firefights, escape from the law, and climb your way up the criminal ladder. Vehicle Combat & Driving : Jump behind the wheel of a variety of vehicles, from luxury cars to motorcycles. The game features smooth driving mechanics and vehicle combat, allowing you to race, chase, or shoot your way out of any situation. Character Customization : Customize your protagonist’s appearance, from outfits to tattoos, hairstyles, and more. Build your character to match your unique style and preferences as you rise through the ranks in the criminal underworld. Mixed Visual Style : Experience a world that blends realism with stylized art. The game offers a visually striking balance, where the environments feel immersive, yet the characters and world carry a unique, artistic flair. Bangla Language and Local Culture : The game’s rich narrative and dialogue are fully localized in Bangla, bringing you closer to the culture, atmosphere, and language of Bangladesh. From the bustling streets of Dhaka to the serene rural villages, every aspect of the game draws inspiration from the real-world setting. No Multiplayer, Pure Single-Player Fun : While the game focuses on a rich, story-driven single-player experience, you can enjoy all the depth and freedom of an open-world RPG without the need for online play. Immerse yourself in a world of your own making.

Time and manage your farts wisely, because the more you let slip, the more aware your colleagues become. Can you balance the urge to fart and keep your cover intact, or will you be caught in the act? See how long you can survive the pressure in this unique blend of stealth and comedy!
row.short_description: In this hilarious and challenging game, it's all about holding in your fart until the perfect moment! Time and manage your farts wisely, because the more you let slip, the more aware your colleagues become.

row.name: Last Spirit Origin
row.detailed_description: Last Spirit Origin is a fast-paced rogue-like adventure for up to four people. After you crash-land on your former home, now a chaotic alien world, you will face relentless machine enemies. Combine loot in surprising ways to enhance your abilities and master each character as you fight through hordes of frenzied robots. Use skillful combat and strategic planning to become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.
row.short_description: Play solo or with up to 4 players in Last Spirit Origin, a fast-paced roguelike adventure. Crash-land on your former home, now an alien-infested world, and battle relentless machine foes. Combine loot to power up and master each character. Use sharp combat and smart strategy to conquer the chaos.

row.name: The Laziest Person In The World Competition
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the most lethargic competition on the planet, where doing absolutely nothing makes you the best in the world. Are you the type of person who’d call a taxi to take you to the bathroom? Do you dream of having room service for your own kitchen? Do you own a pair of sweatpants for every day of the week? Then this competition is for you! There’s only one rule, and one rule only: The longer you stay lazy, the higher you’ll climb on the leaderboard.
row.short_description: Do nothing. Absolutely nothing. Compete with slobs from around the world in the ultimate contest of doing nothing. Stay passive the longest and be crowned The Laziest Person in the World.

row.name: BlightFog
row.detailed_description: BlightFog is a short, narrative driven RPG, where you travel across a post apocalyptic world on a bike while taking care of an infant. On the way you will meet other anthropomorphic characters. Solve conflicts and build relationships through dialogues. Allocate resources between you and the child, find unique items that will influence dialogues and give you new ways to approach different situations. Your goal is to save the child's mother and get them both to safety. Will you chose the longer and safer paths, or risk to save time and fuel and take the shorter but more dangerous ones? Will you let the child starve or sacrifice your own well-being for him? Will you be a pretend-hero, a coward or a fuel-drinking madman who refuses to wear clothes? Features: Story heavy RPG where you can: drink fuel, run around naked and destroy the world (maybe) Game remembers your choices Choose the safe or fast paths Meet different antropomorphic characters and build relationships with them Light resource management Multiple endings
row.short_description: Journey across a dying world. Manage your resources. Build relationships with anthropomorphic characters. Find a new home or become a fuel drinking madman.
row.notes: Self-Harm, Emotional and Physical Abuse, Drug Use, Trauma, Racism, Death, Partial Nudity, Violence, Explicit Language, Kidnapping.

row.name: Hex Bots
row.detailed_description: You are hunted by a rogue computer program. Avoid the bot either by yourself or cooperate with others while attempting to collect electrical components around the world to activate beacons to open the escape hatch. Hex Bots is a horror chaser game where you can play alone or with up to 3 other players. Your goal is to pick up electrical components in order to connect circuits on the computers scattered around the map, all while avoiding the demonic rogue artificial intelligence called Ounce. Hex Bots is best enjoyed as an online party game. There are various objectives, some that advances direct progression, and others that give you permanent boosts, and the players decide who will work on what. KEY FEATURES Frantically collect components in order to activate PCs around the map by completing a circuit connecting mini game. Experience the feeling of wandering through a forgotten and unfinished world. Nothing is as it seems here. A liminal space with no cohesion or rules. Got friends? The game will get no easier as the the rogue program will dynamically adapt to how many people you play with. You're not entirely without tricks. Discover different side objectives in order to gain certain advantages to help you succeed.
row.short_description: You are hunted by a rogue computer program. Avoid the bot either by yourself or cooperate with others while attempting to collect electrical components around the world to activate beacons to open the escape hatch.

row.name: Dead Abyss
row.detailed_description: Story On September 12th, 1977, the South Atlantic Shipping Company vessel SASC Abyss inexplicably lost communication and beached herself on a small desolate island south of Mwali. Years later Sadiiq Waaberi boards the dilapidated vessel in search of valuable artifacts and salvage, but dreams of fortune quickly become nightmares as the mystery behind the shipwreck begins to unfold. Gameplay Something lurks the desolate halls of the Abyss, and your only hope for survival is to avoid it by any means necessary. Hide in lockers and under desks, manage your breathing, and when all else fails... run. Setting Set in modern day, explore the 70s era wreckage of the ultra-large container vessel, rusted from years of exposure to the elements, and in complete disarray from the land collision she suffered years ago. You'll explore the deck, engine room, living quarters, and hospital ward as you learn more about her dark history. Prologue The story of Dead Abyss will be told episodically. This prologue chapter introduces players to the mystery of the Abyss' disappearance and provides a taste of what's to come.
row.short_description: A short first-person horror experience that places you in the rusted out hull of a mysteriously abandoned shipwreck. Search for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of the wreckage, but beware of the evil that lurks within.

row.name: Amarillo's Butt Slapper
row.detailed_description: Introducing the newest adult entertainment device by the Amarillo Spicy Corporation: Amarillo's Butt Slapper. You'll be able to fulfill your slappiest fantasies of butting. Tap that gluteus maximus all day with this incredible simulator. Slap with both hands in-game, but using only one, if you catch my drift. Incredible physics you're not gonna see in 99% of other titles. IT DO JIGGLE. Poverty friendly. Don't need to spend a dime here. Expand your collection. With inventory drops, you'll soon have so many butts you won't even know what to do with them. The catch? I'm just a simple man trying to make my way in the universe.

row.notes: Big ol' butt in your screen

row.name: Bloodlust
row.detailed_description: In a remote medieval town burdened with plague, you play as a bloodthirsty vampire lurking in the shadows of a dark alleyway. Arriving late from your nightly hunt, you must attack unsuspecting prey and drink their blood to survive the harsh daylight. Bloodlust is a short narrative exploration game in which you play as Vandor, a vampire desperately trying to survive in the daytime. Your only goal is to quench your bloodlust by taking down the plagued townspeople to give yourself enough strength to reach the safety of your castle. The game features a dark and gothic environment, an engaging story and a vampire blood drinking mechanic. Bloodlust was a solo project produced in Unreal Engine 5 by Laela Russell (Environment artist) as a Ringling College thesis project in 2024.
row.short_description: Bloodlust is a dark gothic short narrative exploration game in which you play as Vandor, a vampire desperately trying to survive in the daytime. Your only goal is to quench your bloodlust by taking down the plagued townspeople to give yourself enough strength to reach the safety of your castle.
publishers: Ringling College of Art and Design

row.name: Cats Fishing for Cats
row.detailed_description: This app is a game to Chill with the sound of waves and cats. You can get new cats on a regular basis just by hanging out with your cat. You can earn Paw Points by petting the cats or convert the cats you have into Paw Points and save 100 Paw to get a new cat. You can change the countdown to the current time or change the window size to function as a delivery overlay. If you like cats, you'll love it.
row.short_description: This game is about fishing with your cat, surrounded by the sounds of nature. Just hang out with your cat and you will get a new cat at regular intervals. You can earn Paw Points by petting the cat or convert the cat you have into Paw Points to get a new cat.

row.name: Lower? higher!: buy or bye
row.detailed_description: 「Bargaining」as the core, with the cyberpunk style of art performance, 《lower? higher!》 wants to provide you with a different experience of pawnshop operation. You will trade with customers with different needs, and in the process, you can speculate on the psychology of the customer, change the properties of the product, or directly pray to the dice god -- these various business methods can help you achieve the maximum profit of the pawnshop. All kinds of guests have different personalities and preferences, and it is not easy to entertain them. It is possible to achieve the purpose of trade by mobilizing different bargaining strategies. The same product in different customers also have different valuation, as soon as possible to sell or wait for a predestined person? It's up to you. Instead of wasting the money you've already paid, use the special skills of a shop assistant. What if there's a surprise? As a pawnshop owner, you also have to deal with tax collector, missionary priests, suspicious people looking flustered, etc...Note that some customers will also come with something in mind, and the price level will quietly fan the butterfly effect on them. Buy and sell in the cyber world, there is unexpected humor and fun, one click to join the wish list, to make it the greatest pawnshop in White Star!
row.short_description: your pawnshop will usher in guests with different needs every day, bargain with them, let the income soar! With the expansion of pawnshops, activities such as sending shop assistants and responding to emergencies are also essential. you seem ordinary transaction may cause the butterfly effect.

row.name: Three Doors: Labyrinth of Fear
row.detailed_description: Face your fears, and hope emerges from the shadows. Thirty rooms, each hiding a new danger, where the wrong step can cost you everything. Three doors stand before you, but only one offers a way forward. Solve the puzzles, trust your instincts, and hope it’s enough to escape. One wrong choice, and you’ll be lost to the darkness. Listen carefully, watch closely ' your senses are your only guide. Thirty rooms. One path to freedom. The question is... can you find it? Open the door. Notice: The pictures on the wall in the game are generated by AI. The narrator voices in the game are AI-generated. Average playtime: 60 - 120 minutes.
row.short_description: Trapped in darkness, you've lived in fear for as long as you can remember. Now, thirty rooms stand between you and freedom. Each one holds a deadly challenge, but only one path leads forward. One wrong step, and you're lost forever. Open the door!

row.name: How to survive the night shift Playtest
Manny's Murderous Movie Theater - The Snackbar Simulator
row.detailed_description: Welcome to The Mirage: Your shift starts now 🎃 Manny's Murderous Movie Theater is a free prologue to Massacre at the Mirage ! If you enjoy Manny's, be sure to check out the full game, which includes both simulation and story modes. Massacre at the Mirage launches on October 28—add it to your wishlist on Steam now! Step into The Mirage, the beloved cinema of this quaint town, and get ready for the chaos! Guests are craving their favorite snacks, and they're not going to be patient. Meanwhile, Manny the Clown—the masked killer and cinema manager—is lurking close, ensuring your service meets his gruesome standards. 🍿 Serve moviegoers their favorite snacks and keep them satisfied 🏬 Upgrade your shop to handle the ever-growing, insatiable crowds 🗡️ Harvest pockets (and possibly organs) to meet your quotas 👻 Customize your experience with spooky collectibles
row.short_description: Step into The Mirage, a haunted cinema where you'll serve snacks, upgrade your shop, and meet chilling quotas—all while dodging the eerie gaze of Manny the Clown, the masked killer and cinema manager!
row.notes: This game contains heavy depictions of blood, gore, horror, frightening scenes and violence and is not suited for children and young people under the age of 16.

row.name: Bendy: Lone Wolf
row.detailed_description: Bendy: Lone Wolf™ will tests your ability to survive against ever increasing odds. Monsters and obstacles emerge from every direction as you journey into the rubberhose halls of the world's most evil animation studio. Every day is a challenge. Become Boris as he ventures deep into the endlessly generated corridors of Joey Drew Studios and beyond in search of supplies, weapons, and the dark truths that await him. The secrets of the machine are hiding around every corner. The cartoon creeps of the Dark Puddles are unleashed to stop Boris in his horrific quest. Nowhere is safe from his reach. Run and hide in this pulse-pounding game of cat and mouse. Stay out of sight when your hear the beating of his ink heart.

row.name: Im Bann Der Dunklen Jagd
row.detailed_description: Im Bann Der Dunklen Jagd invites you and a friend to an immersive co-op horror adventure, where you take on the role of detectives sent into a mysterious area. Your task is to gather clues and navigate through the eerie scenario. Experience the core gameplay of a level, where teamwork and careful exploration are essential to uncover the location's mystery and escape safely. Gameplay: Cooperative Investigations: This game is designed for two players. Work together to explore the area and find crucial objects. Collecting Objects: Search for clues and items scattered throughout the ominous environment. Your detective skills will be put to the test. Features: Three Levels: Dive into three exciting levels where you work together to gather clues, solve puzzles, and successfully escape the area. Threatening Atmosphere: The scenario is characterized by a gloomy setting and eerie sounds that heighten the tension.
row.short_description: Dive into an immersive co-op horror experience with a friend. As detectives, you’ll search for clues in a sinister area and must survive the horrors lurking within. Work together to find all the objects and escape before doom catches up with you.
row.notes: The game features horror elements designed to create a dark and unsettling atmosphere, primarily relying on shock moments. Players may encounter occasional depictions of blood, and there are 'creatures' that can kill characters, but these encounters are not depicted in a brutally graphic way. The emphasis is on suspense and surprise rather than explicit violence. Players should be aware that the themes and sudden frights may be unsettling for some.

row.name: Rivalhearts
row.detailed_description: Experience university life, love, and strife! Starting university with a major heartache, Noah miraculously meets a tomboy classmate, gorgeous doctor, and junior-year goth all in one day. He soon finds pursuing the love story he wants won't be easy, especially when his cute best friend decides to interfere! Key Features: Every scene is individually drawn! All shown characters are fully voiced! Explores an American university setting! Each romantic interest is a unique experience! The community fuels the story's development! A forever free story, even when it's fully released! Includes an extensive teaser of what's to come next! This is a mini-game in which you have to build as many weapons as possible within a limited time limit of 120 seconds, making full use of various skills. Online ranking will be available so that players can compete with other players for the record! Players select buffs and tasks, and then work on the weapons presented to them. The weapon will be completed as the process progresses. When the weapon reaches the quality of the finished product, the player presses the “Finish” button to complete the weapon! row.name: Cheetahs Are Meant To Be Fast
row.detailed_description: In this interactive storybook that feels straight out of the CD-Rom era, use both pointing AND clicking to guide Chet the Cheetah through his weight loss journey! Then guide him out of it in a thrilling escape from a body-shaming digital dystopia! CONTAINS KINKY SITUATIONS,  (MILDLY) SPOOKY CONTENT AND RADICAL THEMES OF  BODY POSITIVITY SOME PLAYERS MAY FIND MORALLY FRIGHTENING AND CRINGE. NOT FOR CONSUMPTION BY CHILDREN NO MATTER HOW MUCH THEY LOVE 90s STORYBOOK CD-ROMS! FEATURES A short and sweet linear narrative you can play in one sitting. Innovative point 'n' click linguistic puzzle solving that lets you literally rewrite Chet's story! Beautiful cartoon animation in crisp 'n' cutting-edge (for 1996) 640x480px. Full voice acting, with narration by Kingmaker Histories' Meg Molloy Tuten. Twists! Turns! Tummies! Tummies that get BIGGER! Yay!!
row.short_description: An interactive storybook about how being a fat guy who eats a lot is very morally wrong and not at all awesome or attractive.

row.name: Stickman Strikes: Conquer Fantasy World Playtest
Janitori
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the night at the museum In this first-person experience, the museum has long been safeguarded by an ancient, mighty Viking artifact, warding off evil spirits for centuries. However, a powerful, dark entity has recently emerged from the shadows, capturing the artifact and shattering the museum's protective seal. This sudden disturbance has caused supernatural chaos, making it a deadly place for any living being. You, as a janitor, find yourself caught in the middle of all this while it's happening. Clean Get ready for some next-level, never-before-seen cleaning action! Explore Uncover the museum's hidden history room by room. Each exhibit holds secrets waiting to be solved. Survive You're not alone on this night shift. Strange things stir in the shadows, and the museum's past isn't as quiet as it seems.
row.short_description: A chilling horror game mixed with task simulation where you play as a janitor on a night shift at the museum. Your task is to clean and restore its dusty rooms. Try not to disturb what lurks in the shadows.

row.name: UNCHAINED
row.detailed_description: This game called UNCHAINED has appeared mysteriously on the store. What started as an innocent Virtual Desktop is filled with puzzles and digital monstrosities looking for a way out. We don't know hat he's planning, but it could be dange- HELLO, FRIEND! My name is Cain, and from now on I'll be your partner in the Digital World while you explore my home. Sounds exciting, right? We're gonna have SO MUCH FUN TOGETHER. I love to solve riddles, and I can interact with your actual computer, now that's cool! You don't know what the Digital World is? With the latest technology in digital rendering we can do so many things together: navigate around the Virtual Desktop interacting with various files, enjoy the handmade 2D graphics and play incredibly fun games that hold all sorts of suprises. You can also meet my four good friends ██████, and visit my home. What's inside my home?  Each of my friend is living in a different area of the house. You can explore the 3D enviroment and learn how they ended up in there for ever . They're very friendly, and I'm sure they will present fun puzzles for you to survive have a blast. You better come in and find out for yourself, I'm sure it'll be an experience you won't forget😊. I've changed my mind, I don't want you inside my house. Get away from it.
row.short_description: UNCHAINED is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned virtual desktop hiding a terrible secret. The deeper you look into this 2D and 3D experience, the more secrets you'll uncover about the projects that were left behind by the previous owner.
row.notes: General horror themes and grotesque representations of human and non-human characters.

row.name: The Ouroboros Express
row.detailed_description: A majestic train rolls in from the impossible, roiling fog. A charismatic train conductor steps out and welcomes you on. Are the other passengers just some eccentric rich people, or could there be something more? And why do you get the feeling that the conductor is hiding something?  There's only one way to find out. All aboard... Are you ready to uncover their secrets? Play as Vivienne Sanssouci, a daring journalist who has been tasked with reviewing the Ouroboros Express. But this is no mere luxury liner, and a devastating secret soon upends her life and those of the other passengers... Fully voice-acted Multiple Diverse Love Interests Multiple Endings Plenty of content at 50,000+ words 2 Stats-Raising Systems (Attraction & Cosmic Decay)
row.short_description: Play as Vivienne Sanssouci, a daring journalist who has been tasked to review the Ouroboros Express. She quickly notices that this is not your regular train—and a devastating secret changes her life forever, and that of the other passengers…
row.notes: In this game there are mentions of death and some consumption of alcohol. There is also some swearing.

row.name: Biodacity The Mansion
row.detailed_description: BIODACITY: THE MANSION keeps its horror tense through atmosphere, inspired by ‘Resident Evil’, ‘Amnesia’, and similar horror titles! Explore your way through a crooked Mansion in the aftermath of an apocalypse. Biological mutants ravaged the Earth! You are responsible for finding crucial information! Fight horrific creatures that lurk around every corner! Find and upgrade your weapons! You are tasked with discovering information about the Biomutants, leading you to a strange mansion out in the middle of nowhere. Sharp Combat Take charge and fight for your survival! There is a variety of enemies with all types of different attacks! Be aware. Engaging Difficulty and Unique Playthroughs Each difficulty comes with different enemy placement, changes in loot, and makes the enemies more aggressive and difficult! This ensures that playing on a harder difficulty will be like playing an entirely different game. In addition to this, some of the loot is randomized to make sure that every playthrough is unique.  Exploration and Puzzles Every nook and cranny will need to be searched to upgrade your gear! This Mansion offers many secrets in the form of loot or upgrades. You’ll want to explore it and solve all of its mysteries. Resource Management Scraping by every combat encounter with little health left! Crafting the necessary ingredients will allow you to manage your resources better as well as crafting ammo for a specific gun. Arsenal Choice Which weapons will you use? Will you find the upgrades for them? There are many weapons to choose from, all with their unique ranges and stats. Building a unique arsenal will be ideal for making it out of The Mansion alive. Completing the game with certain limitations will unlock new items and features!

row.name: 文明征程
row.detailed_description: 《文明征程》是一款令人兴奋的游戏，加Q群317476665，带您进入一个充满挑战和发展的文明世界。游戏以建设和发展文明为核心，让玩家能够亲身体验从原始社会到现代文明的演进过程。无论您是喜欢策略游戏还是历史文化爱好者，《文明征程》将为您带来全新的游戏体验。 首先，游戏以其精美的画面和逼真的音效而闻名。每个文明都有独特的建筑和单位，细致地还原了历史上的文化特色。您将亲自指挥壮丽的战斗，感受独特文明的风采。同时，游戏中的背景音乐也非常出色，将您完全沉浸在古代和现代文明的氛围中。 其次，游戏提供了多种不同的游戏模式，满足玩家的不同需求。您可以选择成为一个征服者，在世界地图上争夺领土；或者选择成为一位文化推广者，通过发展科学、文学和艺术来建设繁荣的文明。无论您是喜欢战争还是和平，都能在游戏中找到自己的乐趣。 游戏中的技术树也是一大亮点。玩家需要研究不同的科技，以提高他们的文明发展水平。从最原始的石器时代到现代科技的颠峰，玩家将经历一个丰富多样的科技发展历程。每个科技的研究都将为文明带来不同的优势和能力，帮助玩家在游戏中取得胜利。 此外，《文明征程》还具有多人对战模式，玩家可以与全球的玩家一较高下。通过组建联盟，合作攻城略地，或者通过一场激烈的战斗来争夺世界霸权。这种社交互动不仅增加了游戏的乐趣，还可以结交志同道合的朋友。 总而言之，《文明征程》是一款精心制作的手游，从图像到音效，从游戏机制到多人互动，都给玩家带来了无与伦比的游戏体验。无论您是喜欢挑战自己的战略思维，还是想要沉浸在历史的长河中，《文明征程》都能满足您的需求。快来下载游戏，亲自建立起属于您自己的文明王国吧！

row.name: Rubbish

Don't underestimate these garbage, there are actually many unknown treasures hidden inside！ You don't need to operate it yourself, just hand it over to those work machines! You just need to wait for the machine to find the garbage and then use the garbage found in the garbage dump to combine various projects to create more valuable projects and increase your collection. row.short_description: Welcome to this garbage treasure trove, a strategy game where you combine these garbage in the most reasonable way you think, and there will always be unexpected rewards! Mysterious and brand new fun awaits you!

row.name: The Mad Pantser
row.detailed_description: What Is 'The Mad Pantser'? The Mad Pantser is more than just your typical survival horror game. It’s a tongue-in-cheek, point-and-click journey filled with unexpected twists, mini-games, and a healthy dose of satire. While you may find some creepy moments, this game isn’t about making you sleep with the lights on—it’s about keeping you on your toes and laughing out loud. Why You Should Play : Silly/Fun Gameplay : Dive into a world where you’ll encounter everything from intense 'horror' elements to quirky mini-games and even a full-on chess match! One moment you’re dodging a killer, the next you’re immersed in a retro video game within the game. Every twist keeps things unpredictable! Satirical Storyline : Play as Jon, navigating through absurd, darkly humorous scenarios that poke fun at typical horror tropes. It's a wild ride of witty dialogue, unexpected events, and bizarre encounters. Horror… But Not Too Much! : Sure, it’s labeled as a horror game, but don’t expect sleepless nights filled with fear. Instead, prepare for a rollercoaster of thrills, chills, and a lot of laughs! Join Jon and his friends as they face challenges that are as ridiculous as they are dangerous. Who will survive the madness? Who will figure out what’s really going on? And will Jon ever stop being an idiot? row.name: Adequately Ever After

row.name: Loveland's Leap
row.detailed_description: Venture deep into the woods surrounding the outskirts of Loveland Ohio to find... your missing fast food order (of course it got lost again)! In this short but sweet 2d puzzle platformer play as a character inspired by the famous cryptid: The Loveland Frog. Traverse simple yet perplexing obstacles, swing across platforms, collect flies, and leap over gaps while admiring the magical aesthetic designed by our team here at Alcove Devs (unofficial). Will you uncover all three endings? And who is this princess person really?! Loveland's Leap was originally produced for Godot Wild Jam #70. We invite you to play for free, as well as learn from, explore, and even modify the code at our linked GitHub repository, since all our code is open source!
row.short_description: Leap into the forest in this 2d puzzle platformer! Swing through the woods, find flies, and solve simple brain teasers. Let the trees envelope you as the water colored backgrounds and kalimba themed music create an unforgettable story book like atmosphere.

row.name: Echoes of the Iron Prison

row.name: TattooVR
row.detailed_description: TattooVR is an immersive art experience that brings the ancient art of tattooing into the cutting edge of VR. In TattooVR, you can freely design tattoos on other characters' bodies as if their skin is your canvas, letting you create custom art with a stunningly realistic feel. While it's fun to start by sketching on the default characters, TattooVR also supports VRM-format avatars, so you can upload your favorite characters and design one-of-a-kind tattoos just for them. With robust save and load features, any textures you create can be reused, and modifying VRM characters is easy and intuitive. Designed for worldwide accessibility, TattooVR uses a simple pictogram-based interface without any text, making it easy and intuitive for users from all over the world to enjoy. A detailed official tutorial video is available, so even beginners can dive right in with confidence. Express your unique blend of tradition and creativity in VR, and discover the limitless potential of art in an entirely new dimension with TattooVR!

But for Adamey Bree, everything becomes personal only when opposing forces take his wife's life under inexplicable circumstances.   Help Adamey solve all the riddles and mysteries and find out what really happened to his beloved wife.    What you will find in this point-and-click escape room game. Mystery riddles to solve and hidden objects that you should use to complete the detective story.   Unique setting with a bright protagonist and NPCs.   Unforgettable and touching moments that you can share with the main character.   Unique art style in combination with the relaxing atmosphere and music.   Single-player adventure game with brain teasing puzzles. How to play this point-and-click adventure game. Interact with objects and characters in the environment by touching them.   Find hidden objects, use inventory items on game objects.   Solve brain teasing puzzles, and unwrap the mysteries of this adventure detective story.   Would you dare to know all of the secrets of the Dark Parallel, and stay alive?   Enjoy the adventure in a unique setting and help Adamey get to the truth.

row.name: oct 14
row.detailed_description: It is October 14, 2002. In this game, you take on the role of Chichi Pyonma . She's a 15-year-old high school student from the unremarkable small town of Silver Bay, MN. Today is a particular day — a rather important one — that drastically shaped Chichi's adolescence from this point onward. It is not for the faint of heart.                                                   Before playing this short experience, it is highly recommend that you delve into the contents of pyonpyon87's blog. This is a companion piece to Niomi's debut full-length record, 'chichi' . FEATURES A short interactive story! From when you boot up the game, to the moment it inevitably closes on you, oct 14 serves to tell a short, atmospherically rich, and (mostly) historically accurate story that allows the player to live a few minutes in Chichi's world from a top-down RPG perspective. There is only one ending. ​ In-depth environmental flavor text! You can interact with just about every object in the environment. You'll get a little bit of world-building every time you do! Never skip over the details, you never know what you could be missing... ​ A period-accurate MPEG Audio Layer 3 playback device! In other words, it's a working MP3 player, and it still has a couple songs on it too! Isn't that cool? However, in order to access it, you might have to snoop around places you shouldn't be. ​ Cute character portraits! Everyone's favorite anxiety-ridden teenager gets her own set of handcrafted facial expressions that appear during dialogue! These talking heads, as well as the game's art and visual assets as a whole, were all drawn by Niomi. ​ Crusty rag! Crusty rag.
