row.name: The Human Test / Restart
row.detailed_description: This application contains two different games. Summary: The Human Test is a series of dungeon rooms leading to a wonderful and VERY exclusive treasure. However, no humans are allowed. Prove to the system that you are made of binary code by completing 9 absolutely impossible challenges, from rapidly seeking hidden light spheres to writing your own name, or give up like any lowly human being should. Restart is a short exploration game developed around a poem I wrote previously. Navigate a few scenes inspired by the poem's verses, and use the latter to solve a few simple riddles, and progress through the whole poem. Gameplay considerations The Human Test cannot be played with a controller (those are for humans only). Restart can be played with a controller, but the recommended setup is a mouse and keyboard. DLSS is available. Realtime raytracing is optionally available, but requires a GPU capable of raytraced acceleration. Academic context: Both games were made in the context of a PhD research on the integration of logical contradictions in video game fiction, along some of my past releases. The operations developed through the creation process will lead to the development of one much larger adventure game in the coming years. This game is entirely free. If you would like to support the developer, please consider purchasing one of the DLCs. Doing so will provide a WAV file of the main soundtrack for The Human Test.
row.short_description: Two games in one! - Prove you are not human by completing 9 impossible challenges. - Explore various scenes directly inspired by a poem, solving a few riddles along the way.

row.name: 中华英雄Online-一代宗师
row.detailed_description: 经典玩法回顾 五大特色门派、动态剧情副本呈现著名事件 　　《中华英雄 Online》的游戏时空背景为 1930 年代，特色之一为融入现代化武器「枪械」，让玩家可体验双枪攻击的快感，还有像「腿功」等新颖特别的武学，可施展飞踢攻击等不同的战斗选择，并结合街机闯关的连招概念，运用三种组合键打出连段的战斗攻击。而武器也有主副之分，善用不同武学，使战斗更富变化，再搭配动态战斗系统，达到边打边走的效果。 　　游戏内共有五大门派，可依照自己喜好加入，包括正气凛然的「中华楼」、诡谲邪气的「地狱门」、黑帮味十足的「黑龙会」势力、龙虎门及神掌门等，各个门派也拥有不同职业，象是中华楼「剑圣」与「武宗」、地狱门「毒宗」与「血族」、黑龙会「刀皇」与「枪神」、龙虎门「棍王」与「腿霸」、神掌门「剑仙」与「影侠」。 　　为能更融入《中华英雄 Online》世界，游戏也以电影般的动态剧情副本，来呈现各角色的著名经典事件，玩家可与知名人物一起互动冒险，象是协助华英雄抵御外敌争取时间，或是将原漫画中华英雄与无敌的精彩对决桥段设计成动画，随机在遭遇机关或 BOSS 出场前播放，让玩家有如欣赏电影般，增添游戏临场感。
row.short_description: 『中华英雄』这部由黄玉郎与马荣成两位大师携手合作的漫画，曾创下辉煌销售成绩，更被改编为电视剧及电影。如今，『中华英雄』将以另一种姿态展现无穷魅力，知名角色如华英雄、鬼仆、无敌、金太保等将现身《中华英雄online》，带领玩家进入拟真细致的3D游戏世界，与华英雄一起创造不凡的命运。

row.name: OVR Dynamic Resolution
row.detailed_description: Lightweight OpenVR app to dynamically adjust your HMD's resolution depending on your GPU frametime, CPU frametime and VRAM. This allows you to always play at the maximum resolution your GPU can handle while hitting your target FPS. This is especially useful for games in which performance varies a lot such as VRChat. Features Make the most out of your GPU by maximizing resolution. Stabilize your framerates by lowering resolution in demanding scenes. Lightweight; uses minimal system resources. Auto-start with SteamVR and minimize/hide on startup for a seamless experience. Customizable; lots of settings are available and can be changed on the fly. Compatibility OVRDR does not work with every VR game as not all of them support changing resolution dynamically and instead takes the resolution set at startup. This is notably the case for Unreal Engine games. Below is a non-exhaustive list of compatible games: VRChat Resonite NeosVR ChilloutVR Arizona Sunshine BONEWORKS H3VR Hellsweeper VR The Forest Until You Fall Vertigo 2
row.short_description: OVR Dynamic Resolution is a lightweight OpenVR app that dynamically adjusts your HMD's resolution depending on your GPU frametime, CPU frametime and VRAM in order to maintain your target FPS and/or maximize resolution.

row.name: FISHERMAN
row.detailed_description: Fisherman is a fishing game where you can click on the screen to fish and get more fish! Fishing can be done every 90 seconds, and the caught fish can be exchanged, opened treasure chests, and a series of other operations. Looking forward to you playing with us!
row.short_description: click start fish

row.name: Magibrick:Chapter One
row.detailed_description: This version contains some cards and the content of Chapter 1 Welcome to the Magic Brick Realm! As a new adventurer, you need to defeat various monster enemies here through brick duel. In a single game, the enemy and you will play monster bricks on the board one after another during the round. Choose your strategy carefully and try to occupy more plots to gain more points. The side with the higher score at the end of the game will win! Monster bricks are the main units in the battle. They have different images, sizes and skills. Sometimes they will also produce different numbers of arcane bricks as a continuation of their influence, helping you occupy more land. . However, it should be noted that arcane bricks tend to be more fragile, and you need to choose to place them more carefully. Various terrains may appear in a single game. Learn to take advantage of these terrains, or stay away from bad terrains. Will these terrains make your plan more effective or a mess? You can choose new cards after defeating your opponents and solving puzzles. Choose a route to avoid risks or challenge powerful enemies. Try to build decks of different styles to improve your card collection.
row.short_description: An uniquely styled deck-building game. Assemnble a deck with the right Magibrick and challenge diverse enemies in different regions. Fill the board, destroy enemy bricks,play amazing combo, and occupy the entire board with your Magibricks, leaving no space for your enemy.

row.name: 欧酱的迷宫大冒险
row.detailed_description: This game is a procedural generation case study for our UE5 online course, Period 8. We created a maze generation pipeline in Houdini and added scenes, props, traps, and other content to the scene using HDA in Unreal. The game took about a month to create, and our main goal was to showcase the diversity of maze components. We hope you enjoy our little game! ·Face various monsters ·Explore and collect
row.short_description: OuJiang's Labyrinth Adventure is an action-adventure game that features exploration of labyrinths, battles, and collecting, as well as a technical test of our Houdini-based level creation.There are various monsters, bosses, and props in the game. We hope everyone will enjoy our mini game!

row.name: Goddess Of Swing
row.detailed_description: More than 60 students from the Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment program at Mittweida University developed their own game over the course of two semesters. Free the world from the capitalist robots Immerse yourself in the glamorous world of the 1920s and step into the role of the Goddess of Swing! In *Goddess of Swing*, you travel through dazzling, jazzy scenes while swinging through the air with your grappling hook and defeating enemies in fast-paced battles. Feel the Swing Use the power of swing to mark your enemies with the Swing Zone and convert them back to Electro Swing through stylish moves. Every opponent becomes part of your rhythmic dance as you prepare for the grand showdown with epic bosses.
row.short_description: Play as the Goddess of Swing, dance through the Roaring Twenties and convert foes back to Electro Swing in a fast-paced, action-packed party!

row.name: RPG Quiz
row.detailed_description: INTRODUCTION A dad is only as respected as his authority over his thermostat. One does not simply touch the thermostat without the proper ceremony of sacrifice. One taco, one dad joke, and a child to hear his chants with the enthusiasm of a 10,000 heavy metal head bangers at an ACDC concert, or in modern times, the will of 1 child reverberating screams of 'Skibidi!' and saying, 'You have Ohio Rizz!'. I digress. THIS......this is the story of someone or something that refused to accept these terms of agreement. Now! One dad must travel across the lands, searching for the thing.....that touched his thermostat! - Cut to the montage!!!! Oh! and did I mention there's questions!???? How does this apply to the story???? YES! Now, good luck on your quest, but most importantly, have a good day! ENEMY SKILL SYSTEM The uniqueness of this game comes from the fact that you are not only answering questions but also trying to counter enemy attacks. Various special effects will challenge your ability to answer questions. You will have to master your skills and use them at the correct time to defeat these tough enemies! ABOUT DEVELOPER This game was developed, 'of the dad, by the dad, for the dad, so we do not perish' - Some Dad. Seriously though, this idea started one summer vacation with the kids. As a life long gamer, I wanted to make something that would accomplish my long awaited goal of being a game developer. I know my children will follow suit in the same path and wanted to create something with them in mind. Both my wife and kids and many friends have helped me with this project. I am blessed to have them in my life.
row.short_description: It's a quiz game with RPG/Roguelike aspects. Enemies can blind, stun and even confuse you using your own tactics against you! You will be answering randomly selected questions, defeating each foe and learning class skills along the way!

row.name: Hockey Super Squad
row.detailed_description: Hockey Super Squad is a 3 on 3 hockey game featuring character creation and lite-RPG mechanics. It is as much a love letter to older hockey title as it is a revamped version of classic arcade sports games. It includes features such as matchmaking and character customization. PICK YOUR PLAY Featuring intense arcade hockey action, Hockey Super Squad offers 3 on 3 online gameplay. Server hosted online matches allows for a smooth experience, whether other players are connected through broadband or the worst public wi-fi! As the game develop in Early Access, it is planned that a lot of additional modes and features will be added, like ranked, tournament and franchise modes. (RE)CREATE YOUR FAVORITE PLAYERS Hockey Super Squad offers character creation and customization features, allowing you to (kinda!) create yourself, or anyone you would like to play! The game allows you to create many characters, allowing to craft a full team for yourself and compete online! CHOOSE YOUR STATS Character creation isn't offering cosmetic options only. You can pick from a selection of lightweight, middleweight and heavyweight. A selection of attributes then allows you to tweak your build to your like, using the following stats: - Skating (speed) - Strength (cross-checking power) - Shooting (accuracy) - Endurance (resistance to checking) - Passing (distance) - Handling (deke) Make sure to create many characters using different stats combinations and find what works best for your playstyle. Even better, match up with two friends, and craft the perfect squad of mighty hockey players and compete online! CUSTOMIZATION AND PROGRESSION As you play, you will level up and unlock more cosmetic options: - Hair styles - Helmets/hats - Accessories - Jersey patterns and colors - Goal celebration songs - And more! Levelling up will sometimes earn you consumables which will boost one of your stats for your next match. Use with moderation... or not!  FREE TO PLAY! 'So wait, so the game is free AND there is no microtransactions? How do you even make money?' Well, Hockey Super Squad relies exclusively on non-intrusive in-game ads to keep the servers running and the game evolving. Those will take the form of ads on rink boards, screens outside of the play area, etc. For the most part, this will feel just like an actual hockey match on TV. Enjoy your free game!
row.short_description: Hockey Super Squad is a thrilling free to play 3v3 multiplayer online hockey game featuring character creation and lite-RPG mechanics. Jump in alone or with friends!

row.name: In Essence: Nil - (MaidxMan) / chapel
row.detailed_description: This is a game about a priestess rescuing a city from malicious factions of people that have taken advantage of it's defenseless state. This is done by purifying enough shrines around the world and killing the faction leaders. The protagonist is Quinine V the Banished Priestess. FPS combat with light RPG mechanics Wide hit-box projectiles that scale steeply with level makes it a relatively easy experience all around, accuracy is not a requirement. Extremely easy 3D platforming with flying mechanics The magical plane suspends matter in the air meaning you have to jump and fly to navigate the zone. A variety of enemies and bosses An un-dead army and a population blighted with magical essence threaten the player constantly. Custom Engine The engine and all assets are made by one developer!
row.short_description: This is a bullet hell platforming RPG about a priestess rescuing a city from multiple factions by purifying enough shrines around the world and killing their leaders.

row.name: The Final Exam
row.detailed_description: Ten minutes. That’s how long the average mass shooting lasts, and in this school, it’s also how long you have to escape. Set in an American high school, The Final Exam places players in students' shoes to experience a choice-driven survival game that mirrors the real-life decisions students must make during a mass shooting. As players navigate through emotionally charged scenarios like classrooms, lockers, and gyms, they confront the challenges and fears faced by students in a world where a shooter invades a place that is supposed to be a safe haven. With immersive storytelling and an audio-driven experience, players go through safety drills like building barricades, hiding in lockers, and crawling quietly to escape the school. However, the only true way to survive is by unlocking five gun control bills hidden throughout the school. The game is free of gore, violence, guns, and blood because it aims to be more than just a game; it’s a call to action. By promoting discussions about gun control and community safety, the Final Exam forces adults to confront a harsh and, unfortunately, too common reality. It empowers players to think critically about the issues affecting their community, encouraging them to become advocates for change. The clock starts now. The Final Exam for PC also supports high-end display setups with 4K resolution and beyond, widescreen configurations, faster frame rates, and more.
row.short_description: This intense simulation recreates a school shooting scenario, lasting 10 minutes. Players navigate halls representing real-life tragedies, collecting gun bills to survive. The game aims to highlight the failure to protect schools and motivate action to prevent future shootings and save lives.

row.name: Pavlov TV
row.detailed_description: Multitude of uses Cast a competitive tournament, share a hilarious moment, film machinima, or create dazzling trailers for your mod content.  Variety of key binds exposed to Steam Input Nearly every possible function of Pavlov TV has mapped key binds. These can be changed in Steam Input to customize to your own preferred binding map.  Interface Options You can choose to display the active match information, player inventory, nametags, utility trajectory trails, firearm boresight lines, and more.  Camera effects Included collection of camera effects you can use to alter the look of your captures such as field of view, aperture, depth of field, sensor width, focus distance, motion blur as well as a photo grid. API for custom overlays Pavlov TV has exposed endpoints to pull data from a match for a variety of uses, most prominently for streaming overlays such as Open Broadcaster Software. Ditch our UI and create your own.  Mod Compatibility Pavlov TV will automatically download mods and compatible dependencies that are published under the Windows platform Steam Deck support You can view matches directly from your Steam Deck.
row.short_description: Pavlov TV is a spectator tool for Pavlov and Pavlov Shack. View live Search & Destroy or Push lobbies, or capture replays on your community server and play them back. A full suite of UI controls as well as an API to export match data for streaming software.
row.notes: General Violence Blood and Gore effects (Can be disabled in options) Mention of illegal drugs: Marijuana leaf on cosmetics Use of Tobacco Use of Profanity

row.name: Spider Land
row.detailed_description: A nuclear war was the best thing that ever happened to me. In the aftermath of total annihilation, one man blossoms, finally set free from the shackles of morality. Spider Land is a visual novel about that man. Once a doomsday prepper, now a scavenger. Life is simple. Eat, sleep, maybe kill if it comes to that, repeat. During the day, you spend your time communicating with a disparate network of survivors. Nobody can see your face through the computer, and that's just how you like it. Come nightfall, you emerge, ready to make the most of what little this world has to offer. Choose from a myriad of landmarks to survey, all housing unique characters and dangers aplenty. Make decisions that will have far reaching implications. Maintain your grip on reality by any means necessary. Then, when the sun comes up, return to your bunker and sleep the events of the night off. Just give a me a reason. All I need is a reason.
row.short_description: There's a spider haunting these hills.
row.notes: Written descriptions of violence and gore. References to suicide/self-harm.

row.name: Project 0.1
row.detailed_description: Project 0.1 is the debut title from a group of passionate gamers who ventured into game development from scratch. Inspired by the addictive action of Vampire Survivors, this game delivers a fast-paced, roguelike experience where you face relentless waves of enemies while strategically evolving your abilities to survive. With 15 unique skills at your disposal, it's up to you to discover the most powerful combinations and unleash devastating evolved versions of your attacks. Experiment with different builds, adapt to the chaos, and see how long you can last against the ever-growing horde. Simple to pick up but challenging to master, Project 0.1 offers endless replay ability, rewarding experimentation, and non-stop action. Can you find the ultimate skill synergy and dominate the battlefield?
row.short_description: Project 0.1 is a fast-paced, roguelike action game inspired by Vampire Survivors. With 15 unique skills to unlock and evolve, you must experiment with different builds to survive relentless enemy waves. How long can you survive the chaos?

row.name: boringFly
row.detailed_description: Roguelike Card Mode: The clever design lies in the randomness of enemies, who can randomly become allies, enemies, or duelists. Memory Casual Mode: Players rely on memory or reasoning to chain combos of cards with the same suit as much as possible, gaining corresponding attribute boosts to defeat enemies.
row.short_description: A casual card game collection. Various card-related gameplay modes are being gradually integrated, with two modes currently available.

row.name: UNLIGHT:Revive
row.detailed_description: Open Beta launched on Dec 7th! About the Game The witch known as the 'Goddess of Fire,' who resides in the 'Mountains of Madness,' is attempting to create an army of the dead to exact revenge. The players are doll-like beings created by the 'Goddess of Fire.' They gather warriors who died with regrets in the real world and aim to use them as a fighting force to invade the surface world. In a world full of war, the dead with various pasts are gathered. Some took their own lives, some were murdered; nobles, poor people, and outlaws—all have different pasts and origins. They cooperate with the witch and her servants to return to the real world once more. The story revolves around various mysteries such as 'the Goddess of Fire's true purpose,' 'Can she return to the real world?' 'What is the relationship between the player and the warrior?' and 'The appearance of a new force.' This is a story-centered competitive training card game. Players explore and conquer quest mode (single player) with character cards to obtain treasure chests, train and customize their character cards, and explore deck construction that suits their strategy, such as focusing on preemptive action, attack, defense, or overall balance. Not only do trained character cards increase their HP and attack/defense stats, but they also learn special moves unique to each character, which, when conditions are right, can deal significant damage and battle effects to enemies. Deck construction is also a crucial factor when battling other players in Duel Mode (PvP), so build your deck carefully yet boldly.
row.short_description: This is a story-centered competitive training card game.

row.name: Dawn of Ages
row.detailed_description: Engage in authentic medieval warfare , loot weapons, and lead your army to battle! At the dawn of medieval history, build your castle and evolve your army using real weapons and armor from ages past . March against hostile civilizations as you re-trace the steps of history. Engage your rivals and crush their empires in battle! 🗡️ No Dragons, No Magic, Not Now, Not Ever. Dawn of Ages is a game that’s grounded in historical accuracy. No fantasy creatures, no mystical spells, just real, historical empires and war strategy games like no other. Every weapon, armor, and tactic you use is based on the reality of ancient battlefields. This isn’t just another castle game — it’s your chance to relive history as it truly unfolded! ⚔️Epic Battles Await! Command your forces in brutal, large-scale battles. Plan and execute strategies that mirror those of real historical conflicts. Customize your troops with historical armor and weapons, and deploy your strategy in war strategy games that will test your tactical skills to the limit. Victory depends on your ability to outthink and outmaneuver your enemies on the battlefield! 🏰Build and Expand Your Civilization! As you progress through Dawn of Ages, you’ll need to manage and expand your empire. Construct mighty castles, recruit workers, and transform your modest village into a thriving medieval city. Each structure you build directly impacts your ability to wage war, train soldiers, and gather resources. Whether you’re looking for the next great civilization game or a castle game that tests your building skills, Dawn of Ages offers it all. 🛡️Customize Your Army and Gear! No two armies are alike in Dawn of Ages. Choose from over 100 unique historical weapons, shields, and armor to equip your forces. Each piece of gear offers different advantages and can turn the tide of battle in your favor. Strategic thinkers will love the depth of customization and the ability to craft the perfect army for any situation. 🔥Engaging Gameplay with Easy Controls Experience the thrill of medieval combat as Dawn of Ages offers immersive, fast-paced battles with an easy-to-use interface. Whether you’re a fan of strategy games or just looking for quick, satisfying battle games, Dawn of Ages puts the power of command in your hands. Build your empire, conquer your enemies, and outlast rival civilizations in epic war strategy games! 🌐 Play Anywhere with Cross-Platform Support! Dawn of Ages offers seamless cross-platform play, allowing you to enjoy your gaming experience on both PC and mobile devices. Whether you’re at home or on the go, you can access your account and continue your journey without missing a beat. Team up with friends or compete against players on the opposite platform. Experience the freedom to engage in epic warfare whenever and wherever you choose!
row.short_description: Experience authentic medieval warfare. Command vast armies in brutal mass battles, utilizing diverse weapons and tactics. Embark on historical campaigns against rival kingdoms or challenge real opponents in epic PvP wars.

row.name: Myrmidon
row.detailed_description: Myrmidon is a co-op puzzle-platformer inspired by stop-motion animated films. You and your teammate take on the roles of a seasoned animator and his new puppet in an adventure full of wonders. What do you prefer: pulling off daring acrobatics under the spotlight, or pulling the strings of an imaginary world from behind the scenes? Explore the world through two unique perspectives THE ANIMATOR moves around the miniature sets of their studio in first-person view. They manipulate the set pieces to clear a path for the puppet. THE PUPPET traverses the imaginary world inspired by the sets in third-person view. It performs the acrobatic sequences set up by its creator.' Work together to clear obstacles The various dangers that stand in your way will challenge your ability to communicate with your teammate and synchronize your actions. Will you trust your animator and take the leap of faith ? Will you be able to reliably spot your puppet and save it from a deadly fall? NOTE: This game is co-op only : it requires both players to have an internet connection. Myrmidon does not include any in-game chat features : it is heavily recommended to use an external voice chat software. About Studio Popote Studio Popote is a group of game students based in Valenciennes, France. It was founded in 2024 by Rémi Leroy. The studio is committed in pushing visual story-telling, compelling gameplay elements and show casing the many young talents part of the project.
row.short_description: Invite a friend online and embark on a puzzle-platformer adventure exploring the bond between an animator and his puppet. Work together to clear obstacles across the sprawling sets of a stop-motion animation workshop and find out to what lengths the power of imagination can take you.

row.name: Monsterfall
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Monsterfall In Monsterfall, you'll compete against other monsters to claim the title of ultimate champion. Choose from six unique characters, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. Master their skills and outmaneuver your opponents to reign supreme. Gameplay Overview In this fast-paced multiplayer game, 2-4 players will clash in a battle of wits and reflexes. Each match is a best-of-rounds competition, with the winner being the first to claim a set number of rounds. The game features a unique 'Sudden Death' mechanic, which adds an extra layer of excitement and challenge to each match. Key Features 6 playable monsters, each with their own distinct characteristics and abilities 2 abilities per monster, offering a range of strategic options and playstyles 'Sudden Death' mechanic, which introduces an element of unpredictability and tension to each match Round stats and leaderboard tracking, allowing you to monitor your progress and compete with friends Local multiplayer support for 2-4 players, using joysticks as the primary control method Compete, Adapt, and Dominate Will you emerge victorious as the ultimate Monsterfall champion? With its unique blend of strategy and competition, Monsterfall is the perfect game for players looking for a fun and challenging multiplayer experience. Gather your friends, grab your joysticks, and get ready to fall into the world of Monsterfall!
row.short_description: Unleash your inner beast! Compete against fierce monsters in Monsterfall, a thrilling multiplayer game where you'll choose from 6 unique characters, each with their own powers and abilities. Who will reign supreme?

row.name: Operation REMODE
row.detailed_description: 'Welcome to WI Corp, soldier. Don't let it go to your head! Even if you passed the written test to become the first Moddie Operator , I still have the training ground to squeeze you! This corporation needs the best soldiers for its private militia, you're gonna need to earn that beautiful new gun , we don't call it M.O.D.D.I.E for no reason!' Proceed through various linear levels inside WI Corp's headquarters while defending it from a perilous threat to its secrets, using M.O.D.D.I.E , an high tech modular rifle, in this new single player, low-poly style, Twin-Stick Shooter. THE NEW MODDIE OPERATOR Play as the Moddie Operator, a new kind of soldier specialized in fast paced fighting thanks to his Dash ability, to dodge in the blink of an eye incoming dangers, and simultaneously Bash away his enemies. M.O.D.D.I.E. : YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD MODULAR OFFENSIVE DEFENSE AND DETERRENCE INTEGRATED EQUIPMENT As the Moddie Operator you will be issued the pinnacle of war engineering, M.O.D.D.I.E., the Modular Rifle. Upgrade it by exploring and finding new Radical Modules and Tactical Modules to combine them quickly and adapt M.O.D.D.I.E. to your favourite play style. A NEW CYBER GANG MENACE The Katari Clan are ruthless criminals in search for the most secret and valuable technologies hidden in WI Corp's facilities, your first day as Moddie Operator could not be more eventful, or could it? LEARN ABOUT WI CORP'S SECRETS, EXPLORE THE HQ Venture the depths of WI Corp's HQ through your defence of the company's secrets and witness them with your own eyes. THANK YOU FOR PLAYING This game has been created as an Academic Project, thanks to the great effort of a small team and the valuable support of AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi (Italian Videogame Academy).
row.short_description: Welcome to WI Corp, Moddie Operator! Proceed through various levels inside WI Corp's headquarters while defending it from a perilous threat to its secrets using M.O.D.D.I.E, an high tech modular rifle, in this new single player, low-poly style, Twin-Stick Shooter.

row.name: Anchor: Quest for Atlantis
row.detailed_description: Dive in and solve the mystery of Atlantis! Explore the depths in this Isometric Action-Game, fight against the Guardians and awaken the powers in your Anchor to uncover the truth behind the fall of the Civilization. AN ACTION GAME WITH AN ANCHOR?: Use the powerful Atlantean artifact to make your way to the city gates. Grab, smash and tear apart guardians defending the ruins. Become stronger by unlocking new powers and attacks. UPGRADE AND EXPLORE SEA PASSAGES: Retrieve all 4 magic rings, unlock ancient powers and potentials by collecting energy from enemies. Customize your playstyle thanks to the skill tree and choose a style that suits you. UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY OF ATLANTIS: Dive into the seafloor and explore ancient ruins full of secrets and riches while encountering local wildlife. Retrieve old records to discover the history of those who came before us. ◉ Anchor started as an academic project by AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of this initiative is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills. ◉
row.short_description: Dive in and solve the mystery of Atlantis! Explore the depths in this Isometric Action-Game, fight against the Guardians and awaken the powers in your Anchor to uncover the truth behind the fall of the Civilization.

row.name: Cemetery Warrior 6
row.detailed_description: A new test for the demon Zexus! The murder of the king of hell did not go unnoticed, and God himself took notice. He offered the demon to take the place of the king of hell in order to restore the balance between heaven and hell, but Zexus refused. The price for a daring refusal is the end of all things. Cemetery Warrior 6 is a dynamic 3D shooter from the first person, with incendiary Heavy Metal! Once again go through severe trials, playing as the demon Zexus! Use demonic abilities - such as instant movement and fire breathing, as well as firearm potential! After each level, upgrade your abilities to become stronger and defeat the five Lords who guard the death star that is about to destroy everything! - Several types of weapons: shotgun, grenade launcher, machine gun! - 20 levels of crazy Heavy Metal! - Various locations with different monsters: Dungeon, golden caves, hellish labyrinth! - 5 strongest bosses! - Magic system: use fire breath, healing, or acceleration!
row.short_description: Cemetery Warrior 6 is a dynamic 3D shooter from the first person, with incendiary Heavy Metal
row.notes: Monsters can explode with bloody splashes.

row.name: CDB6: A Maldição dos Zumbis
row.detailed_description: Neste jogo emocionante, você vai enfrentar 8 fases super desafiadoras, todas ambientadas no glamouroso Corrida Das Blogueiras 6 High School! Corra pelos corredores, pule obstáculos, derrote os zumbis e mostre que você tem o carisma para ser a Blogueira Suprema da escola!  8 Fases Cheias de Estilo: De desfiles no corredor da escola a desafios no baile de formatura, cada fase é uma nova chance de brilhar! row.name: Snowkissed Romance
row.detailed_description: Support us on Kickstarter Enjoying the game? Check out our Kickstarter page to support the full release:  About the Game The Game During your final winter break before college in December of 1994, step foot into the mythical town of Yukihari, based in the Northern mountains of Japan. Arrive at your Aunt’s charming ski resort where there’s plenty of new faces and fun to discover since your last visit! What begins as a peaceful holiday with your best friend quickly transforms into an emotional journey when your older brother crashes with his three college roommates, who happen to be your childhood friends who moved away years ago. You must navigate through old memories and new emotions while relationships unfold during this magical season of love and self-discovery. Every choice you make and action you take matters - Will you build cherished memories with an old flame, connect with new friends, or end the season alone? Features Customizable Main Character : Select your name, gender, zodiac sign, and even your blood type to shape your personality from the very beginning. It doesn’t stop there, you’ll be able to take a personality quiz and create a complete profile for yourself from your appearance to your favorite food and more! Personality Development : Every choice matters. From the way you spend your days to how you interact with the characters, your personality evolves in real-time, impacting your compatibility and story progression. Are you more shy when it comes to love? Or are you more bold and flirty? Your personality shines through in the dialogue and even impacts your compatibility with other characters. Build your Stats: Your personality is uniquely shaped in part through the stats that you build throughout the game including . Intelligence Athleticism Sensitivity Style Elegance Resilience Charisma Charm Stress  Multiple Endings : Whether you find your one true love, create a dramatic love triangle, make a new group of friends, stick by your best friend for the trip, or walk away from the mountain alone, each play-through offers a unique conclusion.  Cafe Mini-Game : Work at your Aunt’s Cocoa Shop to earn extra money for gifts and activities. Take orders and craft specialty drinks in time to complete your shift successfully. But don't work too hard, or the stress might make you sick and send you home for the season! Day Planning : Decide how to spend each day, from hitting the slopes to relaxing in the onsen. Will you go out with the whole group or steal a private moment with your favorite character? When planning your day, be mindful of what activity you do, some take longer than others and some activities can only happen when evening falls. Each location has unique stat boosts and secrets to uncover.  As you play, be on the look out for hidden secrets because there’s a lot to be discovered in Yukihari. The demo is just a taste. The full game will have even more features to discover.
row.short_description: It's 1994 in the mountains of Northern Japan - Are you ready to fall in love? Snowkissed Romance weaves addictive stat-building, day planning, and mini-games with captivating storytelling and plenty of ’90s shoujo charm.

row.name: JOBifAI
row.detailed_description: In this short comedic Visual Novel (VN) with branching paths, you need to convince a job interviewer of your artistic ability by typing out your best arguments, using natural language. With your language skills, you will need to use every clue in the dialogue and the images to win in a battle of wit. The typical VN formula is enhanced with AI interactions that allow for free-form interactions: describe it with plain words, and see how the game plays it out. A playthrough should last at most 20 minutes; try to collect all endings and find all secrets! JOBifAI: Harness the Power of AI to Land Your Dream Job! Imagine waking up to the thrilling news: Grizley Studios, a leading game company, wants to interview you for your dream position tomorrow. The catch? You've completely forgotten what you submitted! Fortunately, you've got a stunning CV and a portfolio crafted by cutting-edge AI technology. Now, it's your time to shine! Can you convince the art director that your work is the perfect fit for their visionary project? Step into the challenge with JOBifAI, where your creativity, wit, and persuasive skills are put to the ultimate test! Key Features: Hand-crafted pixel art and killer soundtrack: made by a team of talented indie artists Dynamic Challenge: Every playthrough is unique! Experience randomly generated series concepts and portfolios, ensuring no two interviews are the same. Unleash Your Creativity: When faced with stunning series artwork and an AI-generated portfolio, it's up to you to weave a convincing narrative. Convince the interviewer that your portfolio is a deliberate and meaningful artistic choice that enhances the series concept. Free-Form Interaction: Engage in a rich, AI-based dialogue system that allows for true exploration of your ideas. Whether you want to elaborate on design elements or discuss thematic depth, the dialogue options adapt to your unique approach! Challenge Your Persuasion Skills: The game employs an advanced evaluation system that assesses your explanations, making each interaction feel authentic and impactful. Can you think on your feet and turn the tables in your favor? Artistic Inspiration: Draw from countless artistic styles and concepts as the AI generates both the portfolio and series artwork. Explore a wide array of visual themes and storytelling potentials! Are you ready to turn your luck around and land your dream job at Grizley Studios? Step into the spotlight, showcase your creativity, and make your case in JOBifAI!
row.short_description: Land your dream job with JOBifAI! With an impressive CV and AI-crafted portfolio, you've got an interview at Grizley Studios! However, you forgot what you submitted... can you convince the art director that you're the perfect fit anyway?

row.name: Tombstone Tally
row.detailed_description: Tombstone Tally is somewhere between bingo and a Scavenger Hunt, where you search a graveyard for tombstones that match up with squares on your card. Play with your friends and beat them in hunting down the many different possible features of the graves! TALLY 'ROUND THE CLOCK Play during the day, at night, in blackout mode, with or without AI groundskeepers around, or with infinite shovels to send your friends flying over and over! Careful though, it's pretty addicting to give someone a good shovel smack, you might never finish the game! VISIT THE LOVELY ARENA When you want something faster pace, try the Arena map! In this smaller map with it's own fast paced mode, be the first to find 5 graves that match the current wave's stipulation. Everyone is searching at the same time, so if They're close to winning do your best to send them tumbling off the edge! BEAT UP THE BOTS If you just want to kill some time, jump into single player and play against the AI! They'll take you on in the graveyard or in the arena. Maybe even turn on infinite shovels and don't stop running while you try to win!
row.short_description: Tombstone Tally is a cross between bingo and a scavenger hunt where you check off squares based on ridiculous tombstones. Play with your friends! Smack them around with a shovel and challenge them on three maps, including a fast paced arena mode!

row.name: Math Dash

As the player runs through school hallways, they must quickly answer math questions to avoid being caught by a relentless teacher. row.name: 小小勇士团Little Warriors Team
row.detailed_description: This is a world where humans and monsters coexist peacefully, without interfering with each other's living spaces. However, one day, the demon became manic and attacked humans who were active in the wilderness for no reason. As the leader of the Blanoy Defense Team, the player was ordered by the mayor to investigate the cause of this incident. As all members of the Defense Team need to be on guard in the city to prevent the invasion of monsters, the player needs to recruit various warriors to form their own combat team. Challenge the boss and show off your skills       The core gameplay of the game is to challenge the wilderness boss, and challenging the boss requires players to switch roles and layout positions to reduce the boss's damage to the team. The combination of professions and exquisite operations are the key to successfully killing bosses. Numerous characters, freely matched       There are a total of 25 characters in the Little Warriors team, divided into 5 professions, each with two skills. Players can form a powerful team to fight according to their preferences and the skills of their characters. Collect materials and synthesize equipment       Each character in the game can wear up to 6 types of equipment, each with 5 qualities. Kill monsters in the wild to obtain materials, which are used to synthesize equipment. Interesting puzzle solving, full of challenges        Some puzzle solving gameplay will be added to the plot to add a touch of color to the game and avoid players feeling bored by blindly fighting. There is a certain level of difficulty in solving puzzles. If players cannot ultimately solve them, they can join the communication group or seek help in the comments. Passionate battle, showcasing strategy       The game also features a challenging training ground where players can compete against another team. The training ground includes four levels of difficulty: simple, normal, difficult, and nightmare. Each challenge will randomly generate different teams, allowing players to fully experience the combat experience of different teams.      The game is currently released in a single player version, and we will update the networking function in the future. At that time, we will add player battles, world chats, guild and other gameplay. Please stay tuned Official communication group: Q group number 891821082 (Little Warriors Exchange Meeting)
row.short_description: The Little Warriors team includes gameplay such as character development, material collection, equipment synthesis, and challenging bosses. The game allowing players to form battle teams according to their preferences and freely switch between controlled characters during battles.

row.name: Corporate Cut: The Hair-Raising Adventure of an Office Employee
row.detailed_description: It’s your first day as the new intern at the Star Cut Magazine company and you notice very early that something is off: all the employees talk about hair, they have the same haircut, and no one is friendly to you. Moreover, they seem to have forgotten what innovation and originality are, together with the old spirit of the company. It’s time to step up and find out what the hair happened to the company… Explore the story of the company You need to understand what is going on in the office and most importantly understand why you were hired if everyone treats you badly. Get to know the company’s story by talking to your colleagues and by exploring an office filled with environmental storytelling elements, combs, brushes, scissors, and “fishy” stuff… Bring back the originality Your colleagues seem to have lost their sense of initiative. There’s no better way to solve the issue than by showing your willingness and think out of the hair - pardon - out of the box. Complete the tasks you are assigned by solving fetch quests and environmental puzzles. Who we are Corporate Cut is a small indie game made by 7 students coming together for the Game World Design course at ITU Copenhagen. We presented the game at TAGS, during the Copenhagen Gaming Week 2024, and won the award for “Best Student Game”. We also showcased the game at the Nordic Game Conference 2024 Malmö, Sweden. We are happy to share this little design experiment with you. If you wish to contact us directly, feel free to reach out via social media! Thank you very much for playing! -The team at Hairington Games
row.short_description: “Corporate Cut” is a satirical adventure set in a bizarre hair-obsessed magazine company. row.name: Pixelite Online
row.detailed_description: Pixelite Online is an exciting new MMORPG that stands out with its unique features and constant updates. Our dedicated team is always active, ensuring a fresh and engaging experience for our players. Dive into the world of Pixelite Online and discover all that we have to offer! Features: Unique Spawns: In Pixelite, explore a world where spawns are uniquely tailored to each area, offering a static yet diverse range of creatures and challenges. Custom Bosses: Encounter epic custom-designed bosses that test your skills and strategy. Corrupt Monsters: Delve into dark dungeons and face off against corrupt monsters corrupted by powerful forces. row.name: Push 3D
row.detailed_description: Push 3D is a digital re-creation of the Push board-game, created by Dave Shedden. In this game, players take turns moving a game piece around a Hex-based board. On their turn, a player can make two out of three choices. They can flip a tile, making it a 'Slip' surface, where moving across them will cause the piece to slip to the other side. Alternatively, players can move their piece in a given direction, or, if they are in a direct line with each other, they can 'Push' their opponent backwards. Can you out-think your opponent as the board fills with Slip tiles? Are you cunning enough to be the Player that pushes the other off the board, sealing your victory as champion? Prove it now, by playing a friend in this online multi-player game. Features Single-Player practice, or Two-Player local machine 'Hotseat' Mode.  (Coming Soon) Vs Computer Mode, where you play against an automated opponent.  (Coming Soon) Online Multiplayer Mode, where you use a matchmaking system to connect online with other players. A monthly Leaderboard, to see how you stack against the World! (Coming Soon) An Art Deco visual style to set the mood. A period appropriate soundtrack to match the visual era. Hosts and Local Players can configure the game with a number of settings. Customization choices for the Local Player, like piece selection and piece color selection. And finally, Steam Achievements!
row.short_description: Push 3D is an online turn-based two-player board game, where the goal is to PUSH your opponent off the board!

row.name: PalSync
row.detailed_description: In PalSync , synchronization isn't just a strategy – it's your only way forward! Control two characters who move at the same time, facing challenges where every action impacts both. Can you keep them in sync and guide them to the finish? Each level presents obstacles and puzzles designed to test your ability to move both characters simultaneously. As the challenges ramp up, precise control and smart decision-making are essential. Key Features : Total Synchronization : Both characters can only move together. Every move affects them both, creating a unique challenge where coordination is everything. Level-based Challenges : Tackle a variety of puzzles and obstacles that require you to manage two paths at once. Single-player Experience : You're in control of both characters, offering a focused experience designed for one player. Synchronized Puzzles : The key to beating each level is moving both characters at the same time, facing puzzles that test your real-time decision-making. In PalSync , the real challenge is moving as one. Do you have what it takes to sync every step and lead both characters to victory?
row.short_description: In PalSync, control two characters who must move together at the same time. Face challenging levels where perfect synchronization is key to solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles. Test your coordination skills in this unique single-player experience!

row.name: Tank Arena:Total Operation
row.detailed_description: Game benefits About the Game 《Tank Arena:Total Operation》 is a MMO competitive military war game. Players command more than 400 different types of tanks, armored vehicles or helicopters on a 2000x2000 massive battlefield and engage in 12v12 team-based battles against other players from all over the world. Travel across the historical battlefield, immerse yourself in the clash between tanks, collision of team strategies and adrenaline-pumping PVP fights. You will enjoy the unique fun brought by strategies and teamwork. ###Train Your Tanks: Create Your Own War Machine In Tank Arena:Total Operation, tanks are not only your weapons, but also your partners on the battlefield. The game provides historically famous tanks from many countries, such as the German Tiger II , the Soviet T-34, the United States' M4 Sherman, etc. Each tank has its unique performance and fighting style. You can gradually improve the tank's armor, defense, firepower and mobility through the upgrade system to create a steel behemoth that suits your own tactical needs. ###The Ranking Contest: Challenge Top-notch Commanders  For players who are eager to prove themselves, the Ranking Contest is not to be missed. In the Ranking Contest, players are matched globally based on their performance, which allows them to compete head-on with elite commanders from all over the world. Through outstanding performance in the contest, players can gradually improve the ranking and unlock exclusive rewards. The ranking contest not only tests individual operation, but also requires keen judgment of the situation on the battlefield and tacit cooperation in a team. Every victory will add to your fame while failure turns into valuable experience to improve your tactics. ###Custom Appearance: Show Your Style and Glory  In Tank Arena:Total Operation, every commander can be unique on the battlefield. The game offers various customization options. Players can add paintings, decals and accessories to their tanks, or even make a customized unique flag. On the battlefield, your tank is not only a war machine, but also a symbol of your personal style and glory. ### Teaming Strategies: Teamwork - the Key to Success In Tank Arena:Total Operation, heroic individualism is important, but victory often goes to those who understand teamwork. There are a variety of PVP modes in the game. Whether it is in a 5v5 small-scale battle, or a 12v12 large-scale team battle, the successful execution of each tactic such as a frontal assault, a flank attack or a bypass attack, depends on the tacit understanding and cooperation between teammates. In battle, you need to keep an eye on your teammates, adjust your strategy and fight with the team for the victory. ### Real Battlefields: Immerse Yourself in the Grand Wars of WWII Tank Arena:Total Operation takes you back to the battlefield of WWII with its exquisite visuals and perfectly reproduced battle scenes. Each map is designed based on the real battlefield of WWII. From the cold snowfields of the Eastern Front to the ruins of street battles of the Western Front, every detail allows you to immerse yourself in the real history. Combined with realistic sound effects and environmental interactions, you will feel the most realistic battle ambience here.
row.short_description: Tank Arena:Total Operation is a free MMO war game where you play as a commander, drive thousands of types of tanks, armored vehicles or helicopters on a massive battlefield engaging in 12v12 team-based battles against players globally. Enjoy the fun!

row.name: RZR
row.detailed_description: Try to survive the maximum number of days on an island infested with zombies. Collect resources to stay alive, water, food. Look for firearms or melee weapons to defend yourself against zombies. If you feel tired, look for a bed to rest. Coolers will hold only beverages, fridge will hold beverages and food. In the furniture you can find weapons, ammunition and medicines. Some zombies can give you infections, scratch you or even bite you, find and use medicines and bandages for this type of damage. Running too much will leave you thirsty, try to stay hydrated. When entering the houses you may encounter unfriendly guests, be careful. During the night vision will be limited and the zombies will be faster. Be careful to have enough resources at night, as it will be more difficult to find them. Each weapon has a different reload time and range. Don't let the zombies see you or they will try to kill you, run away or destroy them. Some zombies will try to find you even if they haven't seen you, keep moving. Choose the amount of loot, duration of the night, speed of the zombies.
row.short_description: Enter an island infested with zombies and try to survive. Search and collect weapons to stay alive. Move stealthily to avoid being detected and take care of your resources. Handle melee or firearms weapons to clear areas and be able to sleep peacefully

Your friends will serve you well, as your kind's unique ability to exchange limbs will come into play. Different aliens have different abilities, their biology will help you move forward. Can you avoid the security guards and make use of the chaos to escape?

row.name: Spellbound Stumble

When joining a game, you will be added to a queue that starts the match after 4 players have joined. There are two spells that can be used to attack. row.short_description: Spellbound Stumble is a 2v2 arena shooter with an active ragdolls. It uses a host and join multiplayer system to find games.

row.name: Zone Meditation
row.detailed_description: This is a meditation based on 9 kinds of awareness called Water, Mountain, Fire, Wind, Earth, Lake, Thunder, Heaven, and Low. It is a movement meditation, so there is a movement and posture associated with each Zone. There is also a boundary response, and a color associated with each Zone. There is a poem associated with each zone. The zones come from the Chinese Ba Gua (8 Figures) plus a zone called Low (the Low Zone is lower energy). This is kind of philosophical but is basically like Yoga, Tai Chi, or Qigong.
row.short_description: This is a meditation based on 9 kinds of awareness called Water, Mountain, Fire, Wind, Earth, Lake, Thunder, Heaven, and Low. It is a movement meditation, so there is a movement and posture associated with each Zone.

row.short_description: Bolide is an arcade roguelike where you survive waves in space to unlock new skills! Destroy rocks and survive challenging waves to earn skill points and use them to choose from a variety of skills. Pick from 40+ skills, allowing you to create lots of skill combinations!

row.name: Poly Fire
row.detailed_description: Poly Fire is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using a variety of weapons and characters, you will battle with up to 32 players on Various maps . By managing your skills correctly, you will lead your team to victory. The game includes seven various maps And three various game modes. Team up with up to 16 players to fight in furious PvP matches. Group up with your friends in the squad to bring the teamplay to another level. row.short_description: Poly Fire is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using a variety of weapons and characters, you will battle with up to 32 players on Various maps . By managing your skills correctly, you will lead your team to victory.

row.name: Requiem For a Lost World
row.detailed_description: Engage in thrilling battles against the hordes of enemies Collect shards dropped by fallen monsters, level up, unlock and upgrade your arsenal of 6 weapons and items in this unique twist on bullet-hell games, where you are the bullet producer! Survive long enough to face off against the final boss that will put your build to the test! In Requiem for the Lost World, defeat is just a stepping stone towards inevitable victory. Many characters with distinct abilities Unlock the growing cast of over 25 unique characters. Each one equipped with its weapon, special ability, passive and a set of upgrades that diversify the playing experience. Challenge the world of Sanctuary with your preferred play style! Powerful upgrades and weapons Choose from a vast inventory of 100+ weapons and items to build your arsenal strategically. Every choice you make matters as you prepare to fight and adapt to enemies that may counter your approach. Mix and match weapons to create powerful elemental reactions to wipe your opponents with. Experience the stylized world Traverse the vast grass fields of the outskirts of the Capital, dive deep into dark dungeons of the Capital's undergrounds, or explore the vast snow plains of the Northern Tundra. Beautiful VFX and the mix of 2D and 3D graphics will make sure to keep you visually entertained. Each location is filled with puzzles and points of interest for you to discover. Multiple progression systems Equip characters with relics, acquire their rank-ups when weapons alone are no longer enough and unlock buffs from global perk tree. Each character benefits from different stats, and it's up to you to find the perfect balance or define your own META build! With nearly 40 upgradable stats there is plenty to choose from! Plan your builds ahead of time Strategize your build with a built-in planner and compete in leaderboards for the high score! Or just import them from other players, choice is yours Play with others Tired of playing survivor-like   games alone? Try with a friend, or two, or more! Requiem for a Lost World offers an online co-op experience without altering the gameplay loop we all grew to love. Get stronger together, rely on each other to make it till the end! Or maybe you are a streamer, believing that your chat won't make the gameplay a living hell? With Twitch integration, you can let the chat control your fate. Will they help or make you miserable?  In a world scarred by a forgotten era, only one sanctuary remains. Centuries after a global catastrophe turned most of the planet into a wasteland, the people of Sanctuary live in fragile peace, unaware of the dark history that shaped their world. When a mysterious new threat emerges to consume their last refuge, two strangers, Nishi and Amelia, are thrust into a battle against monstrous creatures and ancient forces that defy reality. As chaos unfolds, Nishi must confront his past, unlock hidden powers, and seek out the legendary Bearers—immortal warriors whose emotions fuel their immense abilities. Along the way, the line between salvation and destruction blurs as Nishi and Amelia struggle to protect each other and their world from the impending calamity. Key features A mix of 2D and 3D stylized graphics with various customizations Shape your story in an immersive narrative-driven experience. Unique characters with individual skills and upgrades that synergize with different builds Elements and elemental reactions bring more depth into your choices Relic and rank-up system brings build customization outside of battles CO-OP mode to play with friends Twitch integration Waifus I guess Constant improvements based on player feedback All that and more for literally free! Note from the developer Making a game with a story and scope as ambitious as  Requiem for the Lost World was a long-running child's dream of mine. I finally decided to bring my idea closer to reality! I hope you will enjoy playing my game as much as I enjoy providing new and fresh content to all of you!
row.short_description: Requiem For a Lost World is a singleplayer/co-op roguelite bullet-hell game combining the fun of destroying thousands of enemies with unique builds and a pleasing stylized anime graphics. Unlock new characters, collect powerful weapons and create synergies with elemental reactions!

row.short_description: A short, atmospheric horror experience about daily life.

row.name: Simple Sight - Crosshair Overlay
row.detailed_description: Simple Sight lets you seamlessly overlay your custom crosshairs on any game of your choice. Steam Workshop support: browse through community-made crosshairs, add them to your library, or share your own. row.short_description: Simple Sight is a minimal and user-friendly app designed to overlay custom crosshairs on any game of your choice. Customize their look, load them from your library and switch between them with ease.

row.name: Inkesis

As a mysterious being with the unique power to absorb knowledge and manipulate structures in your environment, you'll solve puzzles, explore inaccessible areas, and fight enemies. Forge your own path: Use your powers to manipulate structures and solve puzzles to navigate through the library of Arga . Master these mechanics to discover hidden paths and unlock new areas through the library. Fight: Your environment is your only weapon. Your abilities will be key as you explore intricate environments, manipulate the world to your advantage, and face the challenges that stand in your way. Immerse yourself in a magical world, where each discovery brings you closer to the hidden truth at the heart of this mysterious place. Will you uncover all the secrets of Inkesis ?
row.short_description: Help Ink, our hero, fight the evil that consumes the forgotten Library of Arga. Collect Knowledge and control your environment to explore this grandiose building, uncover secrets, and forge your own path in this adventure and puzzle game! But beware, your greed could lead you astray...

row.name: Sub0ptimal
row.detailed_description: Test Subject 873. You have one simple task. DON'T DIE! Use any tool at your disposal to survive! Grappling, parkour, wall running, and guns. Find the truth! row.short_description: Low ploy, linear, FPS shooter that is set in a simulation including physics based bullets and movement with a underlying story to discover. Sub0ptimal is a short game but has great replayability. Try to see how fast you can go!

row.name: Square Jump

row.name: Apple Ring

row.name: Tomorrow's Land

row.name: JUMP! The Floor Is...
row.detailed_description: Welcome to JUMP! The floor is... the ultimate multiplayer showdown that will test your reflexes, strategy, and competitive spirit!      In this exhilarating game, you and up to five other players must navigate a treacherous arena where the floor itself is your biggest threat.      The goal is simple yet challenging: be the first to reach the trophy.  Power-UP System   The arena is filled with power-ups that can give you a temporary edge.   These power-ups include increased speed, super jump, flight and others.   Each power-up lasts just 3 seconds, so you’ll need to use them wisely and strategically to gain an advantage over your competitors. Level Design      The floor can turn into an array of deadly hazards, from explosive surface   and scorching lava to bouncy pads , moving sand and even the outer space .      Each map is designed with multiple paths , unique challenges and opportunities, offering players the freedom to find and choose their route to victory.      But the challenges don’t stop there. The map is littered with traps designed to hinder your progress and test your agility.      From spike pits to moving platforms , every step you take could be your last chance to win the round. Time Management and Abilities      Each round is timed, pushing players to balance speed with strategy . The faster you complete your objective, the greater the rewards, but rushing can lead to costly mistakes.      Players have the ability to strategically throw bombs and plant mines , creating powerful disruptions to enemy tactics.  Strategic placement and effective use of these abilities can turn the tide of battle in your favor.      You'll need quick reflexes, sharp wits, and a keen sense of timing to navigate the dangerous terrain and outmaneuver your opponents.      The thrill of the chase, the excitement of close calls, and the satisfaction of a well-timed jump all come together to create an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep you coming back for more.      Get ready to leap, dodge, and outsmart your competitors in a game where the floor is never safe and every jump counts– let the jumping madness begin!

row.name: CowaCowa: Jinmenken
row.detailed_description: Jinmenken: A Terrifying Night Walk 🎮 Game Overview “CowaCowa: Jinmenken” is a 3D horror adventure inspired by Japanese urban legends. Explore a hand-drawn 2.5D world from a first-person perspective as you uncover the mysteries of eerie phenomena. 🐕‍🦺 What is the Jinmenken? The Jinmenken( Human - Faced Dog ) is a Japanese urban legend about a dog with a human face. While its body resembles a typical dog, its face has human-like features, and it is often seen at night or in deserted places. Its bizarre appearance and eerie presence have given rise to many rumors and horror stories. Some say it laughs or even speaks in human language, adding to the unsettling nature of this mysterious creature. 📖 Story Introduction You play as a young boy searching for his missing friend in a quiet residential area at night. While investigating the rumors of the “Jinmenken” — a dog with a human face — you are drawn deeper into unsettling events and hidden horrors. 🎮 Gameplay Features First-Person Exploration : Walk through the world from your own perspective, discovering clues and immersing yourself in a suspenseful experience. Unique Hand-Drawn Visuals : The warm, hand-drawn art style creates a distinctive 2.5D atmosphere that enhances the horror experience. Urban Legend Horror Storyline : Dive into a narrative based on Japanese urban legends that pulls you deeper into the unknown. Stealth Elements for an Intense Horror Experience : Hide and escape from the “Jinmenken” as you make your way through the game. The stealth action heightens the sense of fear and tension. 🎨 Atmosphere and Visuals The hand-drawn 2.5D illustrations depict a Japanese residential neighborhood, setting a sinister and eerie mood. The curved depth of the environment makes it hard to see far ahead, heightening the sense of anxiety and drawing the player into the unknown. As a young boy, you’ll light up the dark streets with your flashlight, facing the lurking terrors of the silent night. 🎯 Target Players Recommended for horror enthusiasts, those intrigued by Japanese urban legends and eerie atmospheres, and players who enjoy immersive exploration. 🏁 Ending There is only one ending. ⏱️ Estimated Playtime 30 to 60 minutes 📺Streaming Policy Summary Streaming is allowed for both individuals and corporations. Please include the game name and the URL to the store page in the description section. No prior authorization is required.

Pirates of Justice
row.detailed_description: Key Gameplay Features: 1️⃣ Drag and Drop: Place objects strategically to set the path for the bomb ball. 2️⃣ Rotate and Position: Fine-tune your setup by rotating and placing objects in the perfect spot. 3️⃣ Aim and Shoot: Launch the bomb ball and watch it destroy the Marine's building. Pirates of Justice is an exciting puzzle game that challenges you to think strategically and solve problems to help pirates overthrow the corrupt Marine. In a world where the government protects a privileged few while disregarding the lives of ordinary people, it's up to you to fight for justice and dismantle the Marine's oppressive control. Each level tests your creativity and skills as you guide the pirate's bomb ball to destroy the Marine's buildings. With increasing difficulty and an engaging storyline of rebellion, Pirates of Justice offers a thrilling puzzle experience. Why Play Pirates of Justice? Strategic Gameplay: Solve intricate puzzles by placing, rotating, and shooting objects. Immersive Storyline: Rebel against injustice and fight for those the government abandoned. Progressive Challenges: Face increasingly complex puzzles as you rise through the pirate ranks. Dynamic Level Design: Each level introduces unique obstacles to conquer. Bounty System: Raise your pirate bounty with each victory and edge closer to becoming the King of the Pirates. Set sail on a journey of rebellion and strategy. Do you have what it takes to bring justice to the oppressed and earn your place in pirate history? Play Pirates of Justice now!
row.short_description: Pirates of Justice is a strategic puzzle game where players help pirates destroy corrupt Marine buildings by placing objects to guide a bomb ball to its target. Use your wits to bring down the Marine's stronghold and rise through the pirate ranks.

row.name: Dead Sale
row.detailed_description: 'Dead Sale' is an episodic horror game that features different stories. In each episode, players must find a way to escape various locations, mainly houses and properties that are up for sale. However, each of these places has been the site of disturbing, dark, and human events. Main Mechanic: Use a mysterious mirror to reveal what has been hidden. Immersive Atmosphere: Experience a unique aesthetic, with sepia tones that draw you into the dark depths of this game. Dark Backstory: With a deeply disturbing story, uncover the origin of the terrifying events. Multiple Endings: Discover different ways to escape the house, though some may not be as lucky as others. Key Features: Voice acting Sepia tone aesthetic Fast-paced gameplay Photorealistic graphics
row.short_description: You are Marcus, an appraiser exploring a house for sale. Power outages reveal a dark entity hunting you. With the help of a mirror, uncover what’s hidden and escape before both time and the shadow claim your life. Realistic graphics, unique dialogues, and a fast gameplay loop. Horror genre
row.notes: This game depicts acts of violence within a dysfunctional family, culminating in a man violently murdering four of his family members, including his wife, two daughters, and mother-in-law.

row.name: Tiny Shooters
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Tiny Shooters, an intense 2D multiplayer shooter! Dive into a 5-minute deathmatch where every shot and every move matters. Players can choose from 9 unique characters, each with their own style, and enter the battlefield for an adrenaline-packed showdown. Don't worry if there aren't any players online – the game automatically adds bots to keep the action going! Collect a variety of weapons, including guns, grenades, and power-ups like health packs, to outplay and outgun your opponents. The goal is simple: rack up the most kills to claim victory! Explore different strategies, whether you're sniping from afar or getting up close with powerful weapons. Can you outlast the chaos and become the top scorer? Key Features: 9 Characters to Choose From : Select your favorite character to represent you in battle. Multiplayer Deathmatch : Compete against players or bots in high-octane 5-minute matches. Power-Ups : Find and collect bullets, grenades, health, and different guns to gain an edge over your opponents. Bots for Offline Action : No players online? No problem! Bots fill in to keep the action alive. Top-Score Wins : Aim for the highest kill count to take the crown at the end of each match.
row.short_description: Engage in fast-paced 2D deathmatch action! Choose from 9 unique characters, collect weapons, grenades, and health packs as you battle for supremacy in a 5-minute showdown. Play against friends or bots in this thrilling shooter game where every kill counts!

row.name: Floating Star
row.detailed_description: In Floating Star, you will play as a lone traveler, floating in the galaxy while exploring the boundaries of human civilization. Travel through the boring, dilapidated galaxy, and negotiate with the numb space colonists. Manage supplies, weapons and equipment, defeat enemies, and find the end of your journey. Inspired by FTL , EVE and some other games. Key Features: Story Driven -- Somehow, humans have spread to every corner of this galaxy. Negotiate with them to obtain supplies and information. Different choices may bring different consequences. Random Galaxy -- Star maps and events will be randomly generated for each game, and the floating path is planned by you. Strategic Equipment and Resource Management -- Inventory space and spaceship slots are limited, but the available ammunition, supplies, weapons and equipment are endless! It's up to you to choose. Feel free to make any feedback!
row.short_description: Play as a lone space traveler, floating in the galaxy while exploring the boundaries of human civilization.
