row.name: Burntime Remastered
row.detailed_description: Survive and conquer the post-apocalyptic world of Burntime. Features Original Gameplay: Play through the original game from 1993 with some enhancements. Survival: Find food, parts to build traps and people to help you. Conquer: Establish camps around all major cities to win the game. Remastered Visuals: Enjoy enhanced graphics and wide screen support while still being true to its 90s pixel art. Remaster Toggles: Prefer the original graphics, or the AMIGA sound track? Change in the options. About the Development This remaster was done by a super fan of the original game. It was only possible thanks to the ok by the creators, and the many issue feedback by fellow fans. It is fully reprogrammed from scratch using the original graphics and sounds. Issue reports and smaller improvement ideas are appreciated on GitHub.
row.short_description: Burntime is a remaster and expansion of Max Design's post-apocalyptic strategy game 'Burntime' from 1993. It includes improvements like doubled resolution and wide screen support.

row.name: Echoes of Elysium: Airship Builder
row.detailed_description: Unleash your imagination and craft your ultimate airship! Echoes of Elysium: Airship Builder is a standalone experience that lets you bring your wildest airship designs to life using the same powerful mechanics that will shape your adventure in the full survival RPG. Customize every aspect of your airship - from its hull and sails to its defenses and interiors. Whether you're crafting a majestic flying fortress, a nimble scout ship, or a luxurious floating palace, the skies are yours to conquer. The possibilities are endless as you flex your creativity  to create the ultimate airship. Your creations aren’t just for show - they’re future-proof! When Echoes of Elysium officially launches, your airships will serve as blueprints, giving you a head start in mastering the skies and preparing for the challenges ahead. Build now and fly later! We want to see your airships take flight! Share your creations on social media using the hashtag #AirshipBuilder to be featured in our community spotlight. Keep an eye on our social channels for exciting updates. The skies await. Are you ready to build your legacy? In Echoes of Elysium , you’ll soar through the skies on your custom airships, exploring floating islands, uncovering ancient secrets, and battling an army of clockwork enemies. Whether you’re charting your own course solo or teaming up with friends, your airship will be your ultimate base of operations in a procedurally generated world teeming with danger, mystery, and adventure.  Wishlist Echoes of Elysium to stay up to date on the full Survival RPG and get a sneak peek into development.
row.short_description: Unleash your creativity in the Echoes of Elysium: Airship Builder! Craft and customize your airship ahead of the game's release. Echoes of Elysium is an airship survival RPG set in a procedural world where you will gather resources to design, build, and fight to survive on your full custom airships.

row.name: KNOCKOFF
row.detailed_description: KNOCKOFF is a first of its kind Mall Brawler / Isometric Fighting Game set in a dead mall, developed by one person over the course of four years... It is a small indie project made in my spare time, in between work and school and the like! It features a blend of bullet hell mechanics and fighting game combo-heavy combat. After beating a spoooooky tutorial and wicked boss fight, you earn the local PvP and enemy wave modes for fun battles against CPUs or other Players. For those who are excited to play the story, my sincere apologies, the story mode is still in development.. Do you know the story of KNOCKOFF? It's about a girl who wanders an endless dead mall, a plastic mausoleum, tomb of pain and waste. She searches for an exit, trying to escape the shadow of death. The mall is the creation of a dark witch, though the girl doesn't know it. And as she follows the exits, the witch introduces herself as a guide. The witch gifts her a cursed weapon which saves the girl's life once and then kills the girl's friends after. And after wandering and wandering, following the exit signs and doing everything right, the girl finds herself in same place she started. Her journey, her pain, one big loop. She dies of hopelessness. For years she haunts the spot she died, another ghost among the rubble. But eventually, somehow, she regains hope. She drifts the mall, possessing pieces of a mannequin, and builds a new body, with a new goal. She and all her dead friends, together, they kill the witch in a horrible crucifixion. As the witch dies, the mall fades away, like it was a dream that was never there. They stand in a field of grass. For the first time, the girl sees the sky. The game is free and meant to be shared to your heart's content. It doesn't take up much storage, either. In time, a version of its source code may be uploaded so that it is open source for modding and such. For now it is present as compiled byte code which makes it run better. KNOCKOFF is made without generative A'I'. It features only the real art of real humans and real catboys. Alongside my 3D models, animations, stages, and pixel art textures and code, it features some of datamosh videos, a radical original soundtrack, and iconic drawings of my dearest friends. I hope you enjoy exploring The World Shopping Center ! The fight is everything, -PLUSHCATBOY KNOCKOFF LIST OF NOTABLE MOVES: Camilla: Standing Light: In each of Camilla's Gaunts , in each knucklebone, is stored a Sprite. When she presses STANDING LIGHT, she cracks her finger and releases one to bore holes into the enemy. Aimed Heavy: Camilla herself seems undead, perhaps she is a Sprite possessing a body of stale blood. Evidence of this is how frail yet powerful she is, how she hovers above ground and PIT, and how she releases a bloody beam of fire and brimstone with AIMED HEAVY. Amy Standing Heavy: Amy's Instrument is possessed by two Sprites, conjoined in an unholy ritual... though she just happened to find it that way. The eye of this Instrument is powerful enough to, in just a single smash, undead all but the heartiest of opponents. Moving Light: Amy's longboard is a sturdy vehicle, able to take knocks and hits without her dismounting. While on it, she is UNSTOPPABLE. But, the longboard is more cumbersome than the skateboard, and without technical and delicate maneuvers, she is quite likely to fall off. Blue Aimed Heavy: Blue is dangerous in that he is careful. His beloved guitar, Mother, is possessed by... I'm sure you already know. He is careful with her. He can begin to prepare an attack, but hold it just before releasing it upon the enemy, at just the right time. Aimed Light: Blue is also deadly with his Skull Balls. Though the name he has chosen for them is... a bit much don't you think? He can hold these at the ready, and strike suddenly. They have no Sprite inside them, only electricity, which he can use to propel himself at opponents, or propel opponents to him.
row.short_description: KNOCKOFF is a first of its kind Isometric Fighting Game and (tasteful) horror RPG made by 1 person over the course of 4 years in between work and school and the like! Features a blend of bullet hell mechanics and fighting game combat, this wack Mall Brawler is like nothing you've ever seen~!

row.name: The Rose of Cravenmor
row.detailed_description: How far would you be willing to go in service to your people? Would you be willing to kill? You would get no gratitude. No riches. The very people you're trying to help would hate you, fear you, and brand you as but a coin-chasing cutthroat. With the City Watch after you, you would get no peace. Amidst a Biblical calamity, do you have what it takes to answer God's calling and do what no one else would? Features: A nihilistic take on the visual novel genre, presented in traditional format with minimal illustrations; Fully original soundtrack, featuring medieval folk music, sombre ambient, orchestral compositions, and everything in between. Every scene is scored uniquely; Two endings, each exploring different facets of the lore.
row.short_description: A gothic short story set in the most Blighted city of the North Kingdom.
row.notes: Descriptions of violence and mild sexual references.

row.name: Kota`s New Journey
row.detailed_description: A small game made with love and humor. It takes only an hour to complete, but it is completely free. If you like it and it makes you smile, that's great! What is the game about? Kota, an elf cosplayer, arrives in a small village where she will help an old friend, teach magic to an orphan, take part in catching the legendary Sasalmon... well, just play and find everything out for yourself! Unique mechanics! As well as walking, your character can also RUN. And at some points in the game, a cute tiny chibi girl will follow you around. Look for hidden items in each level! Interact with the many inhabitants of the village (sorry, I forgot to come up with a name for it)! Okay, these mechanics aren't particularly unique, I guess. You might have seen some of them in other games... NO AI-generated art or text Every image and word in this game is handmade. Yes, they are not perfect. But you can be sure that hours of human effort have gone into them!
row.short_description: An elven sorceress decides to visit her old friend, but gets caught up in a series of exciting (and slightly lewd) adventures, where she finds new friends, rare spells... and loses her swimsuit.
row.notes: The game contains non-explicit sex scenes in humorous content. Interaction with penis-like objects, sexualized poses, poses simulating sexual intercourse, partial nudity. All characters in these scenes are adults.

row.name: SEGA FOOTBALL CLUB CHAMPIONS
row.detailed_description: From hometown heroes to world class legends! Bring your team to the top of the world. Give the management a refresh and compete in major European Leagues. From local football legends to the top of the world! The beloved soccer club management simulation game from Japan “SakaTsuku” is here for global players with its latest version! Celebrate 30 years of passion and strategy in this iconic title brought to you by SEGA! SEGA FOOTBALL CLUB CHAMPIONS is a game powered by Football Manager ™, featuring player data from FIFPRO™, and allowing you to compete in J League, K League, and more! Become the manager of your club and bring your team from hometown heroes to global superstars. Completely free to play all around the world with cross-platform support and cross-play features so you can play anytime, anywhere between Mobile, PC, and Console. ■Lead your local club to the top of the world! •Build a team where you can recruit the best global football players. •Compete in your selected league and rise from the bottom to be the best. •Develop facilities and training programs to increase your player potential. •Set training programs to shape the player skills. •Recruit and nurture young rising players to become global stars. •Search the transfer market and spot the best buys. •Experience a journey from local beginnings to global greatness together with your team! ■Deep strategic club management! •Shape the future of your club with impactful choices. Decide which players to sign and who you let go. •Endless forms of football formations and strategy that you can create to compete against others. •Build training facilities, world-class stadiums, and develop your team to be the best. •Every move you make shifts the balance of power across the entire league. row.short_description: Powered by Football Manager ™, featuring player data from FIFPRO™. Allowing you to compete in J League, K League, and more! Become the manager of your club and bring your team to global superstars. Pre-register now and be the first to enjoy strategic gameplay, real players, and thrilling matches!

row.name: Dodge It! 3
row.detailed_description: Dodge It! 3 is an exciting 3D action game where players must avoid red balls while collecting green balls to survive. One wrong move, and you're out! With each green ball collected, you earn XP to level up, unlocking new challenges. New maps will be added over time. The key to success is mastering your reflexes and timing to dodge the red balls and climb the leaderboards. Do you have what it takes to become the best and claim the #1 spot?
row.short_description: Dodge It! 3 is an intense 3D action game where your survival depends on fast reflexes. Navigate through a series of increasingly challenging obstacles. With sharp visuals and competitive leaderboards, it’s all about skill and precision as you dodge your way to the top!

row.name: 守卫墙角 Into The Corner
row.detailed_description: A geometric style tower defense strategy game. The defense lines you set up and strengthen will not disappear after winning a game. On the contrary, these exquisite defenses will be permanently retained and become strategic depth on the big map. In this game, you can build defenses, resist attacks, expand territories, and snowball economically to gain technological and military advantages.
row.short_description: A geometric-style tower defense game where your defenses persist beyond victories, becoming permanent strategic assets. Build defenses, repel attacks, expand territory, and snowball economically to gain tech and military advantages.

row.name: Gates of olympus
row.detailed_description: Step into the divine realm of ancient Greece and unlock the power of the gods in Gates of Olympus, a thrilling match-3 puzzle game infused with the epic grandeur of Greek mythology. Ascend Mount Olympus, where the mighty Zeus reigns supreme, and challenge the pantheon of gods as you seek favor and fortune. With every match you make, lightning strikes, oceans roar, and the heavens tremble—will you harness the elemental forces or be lost in the shadows of myth? Navigate celestial temples, unlock sacred relics, and summon the strength of the Olympian deities to conquer each level. From the wisdom of Athena to the wrath of Ares, each god offers their unique blessings, transforming your strategy into legendary victories. But beware, mortal—the gods are not easily swayed, and only the most cunning and daring will earn their place among the stars. Are you ready to cross the Gates of Olympus and claim your destiny? The gods await.
row.short_description: Step into ancient Greece in Gates of Olympus, a thrilling match-3 game. Harness the powers of Zeus and the gods to unlock treasures and claim your place among the immortals. The gods await—dare to challenge them!

row.name: Ball Game
row.detailed_description: Follow the host through a series of increasingly difficult physics based levels, with varying game mechanics. Throughout ball game, you will be required to roll, jump, aim/release, time meters, and rotate walls to get your ball to the finish line. Each level must be completed under a certain amount of time, and make sure to not upset the host.
row.short_description: Welcome to ball game! Roll, bounce, and spin your way through a series of ball based obstacles and levels. Be careful not to fall too many times or take too long, but most importantly, have fun!

row.name: Teddy War II
row.detailed_description: In this FPS, cute teddy bears fight between themselves with fireballs !! You are... a cute teddy bear. It's you... Teddy. :) And you fight against other Teddy bears online, with fireballs, in a cemetery ! 3rd view mode 1st person view The first to obtain 10 frags wins. Easy, isn't it ? So, let's go !!
row.short_description: In this FPS, cute teddy bears fight between themselves with fireballs !! You must shoot other players with your fireballs. Each time you kill someone, you gain one frag. The first player to obtain 10 frags wins.

row.name: Seasonala Cemetery
row.detailed_description: Seasonala Cemetery is a meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery. Using your system’s real date and time, the game changes dynamically – visit in the summer to see the cemetery bustling with life, or explore in the quiet, snowy winter. Observe and interact with NPCs and animals as they visit Seasonala Cemetery , all while listening to ambient sounds recorded from a real-life cemetery. Seasonala Cemetery is a peaceful yet poignant reflection on life and death. Features See how the cemetery changes through the seasons, time of day, and weather. Learn about the city’s history through its gravestones. Interact with the animals that call the cemetery home and the people who visit the cemetery at different times of the day, month, and year. Listen to ambient sounds recorded from a real-life cemetery alongside a beautiful soundtrack composed by halina heron. Pick up flowers, rocks, pinecones, and more and place them on gravestones you visit. A completely free experience for Windows and Mac.
row.short_description: A meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery as it changes with the seasons.

row.name: Whispers Of Fear
row.detailed_description: Synopsis: In Whispers of Fear , you’re drawn into a chilling psychological horror experience. After fleeing from a mysterious stalker, the protagonist seeks refuge in her family’s house deep in the woods. The false sense of security keeps pulling you into a tense and nerve-racking atmosphere. Every sound, every shadow will make you question what’s real. With an unexpected twist, you’ll need to figure out if you can escape or if the danger still lurks in the dark. Perfect for players looking for an immersive, realistic experience, Whispers of Fear will leave you wondering if you're ever truly safe. Gameplay: Explore and survive in a desolate atmosphere, in a house on the outskirts of a forest at dusk. Progressive story as the days and nights unfold. First-person experience, exploration, suspense, horror. Events based on the player's choices and actions. Immersive atmosphere and sounds. Psychological horror, realism. A story that could happen in real life. Retro setting. The story progresses based on objectives.
row.short_description: You step into the shoes of a woman being stalked by a mysterious figure. What was supposed to be a safe haven in an isolated forest house turns into a nightmare as strange events unfold during the night. Each night grows more terrifying... Can you escape before it’s too late?

row.name: Motorbike Evolution 2025
row.detailed_description: I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day. Motorbike Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery? Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind. - 80 motorbikes from 120 years of history - 50 real and custom tracks - 1000+ various vehicle setups - 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable - 10 different biomes Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motorbikes with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them! The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!
row.short_description: Your favorite indie motorbike MMO is back! Experience the evolution of motorbikes with up to 39 friends!

row.name: Reindeer Racing
row.detailed_description: Reindeer Racing is a quirky and casual racing game where you race against up to 8 players worldwide. Sabotage the environment to cross your opponents, throw snowballs or ram into objects to trigger these traps. You are a reindeer racer in a no-holds-barred race in the cold north, which means you will have to do anything to get ahead of your opponents on the track and win the race, even if it means playing dirty. Race Easy to learn, fun to master: Jump into the game whenever you want, and master along the way. Chaotic, fast-paced gameplay: There is always something going on, and something to do on the track, whether it is navigating dangerous roads, setting traps for opponents or clashing with other racers. Quirky controls: Control the chaotic and unruly reindeer that pull your sled through the harsh conditions of the cold north. Sabotage Dynamic environment: Interact with the environment around the track to give yourself an advantage in the race. This could be through traps, obstacles or secret routes. Variety of sabotaging: Activate traps in the environment by hitting them or throwing snowballs at them. These can be falling icicles, exploding tree trunks or even large snowballs. Multiplayer Play with friends: Play against your friends with up to 8 players. Note This game was made as a school project by a group of 7 students from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences, Finland.
row.short_description: Reindeer Racing is a quirky and casual racing game where you race against up to 8 players worldwide. Use falling trees and a variety of other obstacles to hinder your rivals as you race to victory and climb the leaderboard.

You play as a secret spy, who enters the facility, and must collect information about this zombie. But watch out! The SCARY MAGIC ZOMBIE is extremely dangerous. Be very careful. - The gameplay is very simple. You walk through the facility, and use the left mouse click button to open doors and pick up documents. row.name: 失欲
row.detailed_description: The English version is still being translated and produced. The following content is machine translated. Please note This is not a game with high playability. It is just a simple novel reader I made. It cannot be regarded as a visual novel, a demo, or even a qualified novel. It is at most a slightly processed script. I am ashamed that due to my limited ability, my programming skills can only support me to make some simple 2D platform jumping and turn-based games. The music and art are even worse. Why not publish the script on the novel platform? Because my literary literacy is very poor, I have failed Chinese for many years since the third grade of elementary school. I don’t have the ability to expand the script to be more substantial, add more branch content and more character creation. In short, I can’t write so many words. If I simply process the script of 'Lost Desire' and post it on the novel platform, I will have to finish it in a hundred chapters at most, and the outline I have been thinking about for more than a month will be wasted. And can people sign the contract of those novel platforms? Even the Qing government dared not sign it! The clauses in it are all about me, as the second party, having to bear many responsibilities, and what will happen if I breach the contract. There is no mention of the responsibilities and penalties for breach of contract of the company of the novel platform as the first party. This is an unequal treaty at all. Even if we don’t talk about signing, the novel platform has many requirements for the number of words, structure and content of the novel, and they are double-standard: I want to use Greek letters to represent the if story line, but I was told that 'the chapter name must be named as Chapter XX', haha^^; I want to use rich text to emphasize the content, lay the groundwork and echo the title, but it’s not possible, only black and white words can be chosen; I want to write a short epilogue or summary, but it can’t reach 1,500 words, so I can’t upload it; I want to write some dark and cruel content, but I have to change this and that, but those great writers write dark and cruel, pornographic, gambling, and even cults, and political establishment content much more excessive than me, what is this if not double standard? Current plan Currently I plan to finish writing all six chapters of 'Lost Desire' plus one extra chapter, and then see if there are any friends willing to cooperate and make something big together. You can contact me through social media links. If there is no suitable partner, I will gradually use AI technology to process 'Lost Desire' into a real visual novel.
row.short_description: 《失欲》是一部基於帝國主義時期歐洲的短篇反烏托邦小說，它通過多線敘事，描繪了奧盧格帝國從資本主義逐漸過渡到半奴役制度的過程，呼籲人們反資本、反戰、反封建。 The English version is still being translated and produced.

Когда вы вернетесь в деревню Самайн 1, вы встретите бандита. Чтобы победить бандита, вам нужно прокачаться до 8 уровня и купить базовую броню, прежде чем с ним сразиться. Once you reach level 3, you will unlock the ability to use area spells. After that, speak to the elder in the town of Chorya to receive a quest to find his wallet. Head to the Samain Village Passage-1 to locate the elder's wallet, then go to Green Park to receive a quest from a young man named Jang Min-soo to find his tuition fee. When you return to Samain Village 1, you'll encounter a thug. To defeat the thug, you need to level up to 8 and purchase basic armor before you can win the fight. After that, you can continue to receive quests from the villagers, solving their problems to progress to the next map in a similar manner. row.name: Myrmica
row.detailed_description: The year is 2058. In a dystopic future where the USA leads as the de facto only world power, play as Liv: An agent of the S.I.N (Supernatural Investigations Network). You will be sent to an oil station in the middle of the Pacific, stuck in 1982. Your mission? Discover what’s causing problems in the system so the station can continue working without being noticed. But this place is full of secrets and Liv is just a cog in the machine. Explore a petrol station (Complex B13B) full of secrets and mysteries. The environment and the people who live in it will react to your actions and the events happening at the station. Rooms, lights, dialogues, and so much more will change... with time.  Explore and test the possibilities of the time loop while making your way to uncover the truth. Meet Frank, Alice, Needle, Kira, and The Archivist. Learn their stories, secrets, and motivations. Everyone has a key role in Complex B13B and yours will be to find it. With a sprawling dialogue system that’ll let you confront them as you please. Good cop or bad cop? And more important. What would you do when you discover their stories? The T.M.R (Time Manipulation Recorder) is the main tool of Myrmica. With it, you can investigate and manipulate the characters and the world around you. Thanks to the T.M.R, you can create your own solutions and situations, use their routines to your advantage, and explore the way to solve the mysteries the station holds. This game is a university project by students at U-tad. The masters involved are design, art, programming, modeling, concept, animation, rigging, and production from U-tad and the master's degree in musical creation and production from Loyola University.
row.short_description: Myrmica is an investigation and puzzle adventure viewed from an isometric perspective. Explore a petrol station while chased by a time anomaly. row.name: Chess 'n' Blocks
row.detailed_description: Have you ever considered playing Chess and Tetris simultaneously? Guess what? My strange brain did for years; I don't know why. But I finally took the time to create this game. And that's how chess 'n' blocks was born. The game is designed to be straightforward. Two players engage in a fast-paced chess match, known as blitz mode. You both have 5 minutes to play all your moves. When it's your turn, a timer decreases until you make your move. If this timer reaches 0, you lose. Simple right? But that's not all. Once the first move is done, Tetris pieces start falling! And if you lose at Tetris or chess, you lose, too! But I also wanted to connect both games; how? That's the funny part: if you take a piece at chess, a line spawns at the bottom of your opponent's Tetris, making it harder for them. But what if it's not your turn at chess? Then try to break three lines on your Tetris to add two to your opponent's one! Or make a Tetris by breaking 4 of them and adding three lines this time! Quite simple, right? Focusing on both games is not easy at all! But it's the spice!

row.name: HappyHazard
row.detailed_description: This is a survival adventure game inspired by Resident Evil 2, but without the horror element. The player receives a mission to find treasure, exploring vast stages, solving puzzles, and either avoiding or defeating enemies while trying to escape. Strategic gameplay is required due to the limited resources and inventory system, offering tension and a sense of challenge without relying on fear. Key Features Puzzle Solving and Treasure Hunting: Players must find hidden treasures and solve puzzles across various stages, with the ultimate goal of escaping.
